dossier.claim: Several passages change how magical bodies are experienced or reduced to instruments: sensations become anatomical actions, becoming a circuit becomes making one, and bodily rejection or replacement acquires a different subject or mechanism. These changes run in different directions; they do not establish consistent sanitization.
dossier.sourcePattern: Rin's summoning distinguishes her human body from its circuit state; Shirou's archery reflection makes self-erasure a means of becoming a conduit. His training uses an intangible, poker-like circuit, and later narration explicitly describes releasing a sensation. Elsewhere, writhing limb sensations, a dying body becoming a thing, and unnamed vital material leaving a wound preserve distance between subjective experience and anatomical description. The worm passage separately distinguishes preserved appearance from replaced contents.
dossier.englishEffect: The English makes stigmata perform the rejection, substitutes circuit-making for becoming a circuit, and gives the training circuit multiple metal rods. Releasing a sensation becomes removing a nerve, while writhing sensations become moving limbs. Sakura's threatened nerve damage becomes asserted shredding. In the death and wound passages, objectification becomes rigidity and outward loss becomes internal organ movement. The worm passage instead preserves flesh and bones. These changes alter agency, certainty, or bodily imagery in different directions.
dossier.limits: The English also preserves Rin's transformation into a component, Shirou's painful circuit preparation, continuing magical depletion after bodily recovery, and the qualified response of Sakura's worms. Nearby self-transparency and dehumanizing language often survive even where a particular phrase changes. These examples do not establish systematic sanitization, a universal change in characterization, literal medical outcomes, or a single rule governing magical bodies. A temporary magical nerve is not assumed to be an anatomical nerve removed surgically; the relevant local change is from releasing a sensation to removing an object.
dossier.diagnostic: 368 findings in this category; 9 cited passages.

findings.sourceReading: Ugly streaks or cordlike structures run along Shinji's skin and connect his body to the flesh mass.
findings.explanation: Structures running along Shinji's skin become muscles rippling beneath it. The English adds movement and a more specific anatomical location.

contexts.japanese: その肌に走る醜い筋が、身体と肉塊を繋げている。
contexts.english: Ugly muscles ripple under the skin, connecting the body to the flesh hunk.

findings.description: The curse becoming fatal on the first step becomes each step merely approaching fatality.
findings.sourceReading: Its nerve invasion, strength theft, and brain-boiling effect is already lethal once a person takes one step; an ordinary person stops after two.
findings.explanation: The curse becoming fatal on the first step becomes each step merely approaching fatality.

contexts.japanese: 一歩歩いた時点で致命的となる。
contexts.english: every step taken is a step closer to fatality.

findings.description: The collision shaking Shirou inside and outside becomes shaking everything around him.
findings.sourceReading: Swords launched from within his body strike incoming swords, so impact shakes both his interior and exterior.
findings.explanation: The collision shaking Shirou inside and outside becomes shaking everything around him.

contexts.japanese: 衝撃が内と外を震わせる。
contexts.english: the impact shakes everything around.

findings.description: Shield fractures causing Shirou's body to lose pieces becomes his body being full of holes.
findings.sourceReading: The shield is already moth-eaten with holes; because it is Shirou himself, each fracture has chipped away parts of his body even though the projectiles have not physically reached him.
findings.explanation: Shield fractures causing Shirou's body to lose pieces becomes his body being full of holes.

contexts.japanese: その時点で衛宮士郎の体は欠けている。
contexts.english: my body is full of holes already.

findings.description: Shirou’s left hand failing to move at all in the crucial instant becomes moving too slowly.
findings.sourceReading: Although he knew the fourth plate was falling, his left hand would not respond when he reflexively needed it.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s left hand failing to move at all in the crucial instant becomes moving too slowly.

contexts.japanese: 左手が咄嗟に動いてくれなかった。
contexts.english: my left hand didn't move fast enough.

findings.description: Shirou’s uncertainty about whether pain made him lose consciousness becomes merely being unable to bear it.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot tell whether he finally blacked out because the pain became unbearable or whether the pain stopped unnoticed before he slept.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertainty about whether pain made him lose consciousness becomes merely being unable to bear it.

contexts.japanese: 痛みに耐えきれなくなったのか、それとも知らないうちに痛まなくなったのか。
contexts.english: I must've not been able to bear it anymore, or it stopped hurting before I knew it.

findings.description: Sleeping with an arm trapped under his body becomes deliberately using it as a pillow.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou compares the numbness to waking after accidentally sleeping on and cutting circulation to an arm.
findings.explanation: Sleeping with an arm trapped under his body becomes deliberately using it as a pillow.

contexts.japanese: 腕を下敷きにしちまって、起きたら血が通ってなかった
contexts.english: If I use my arm as a pillow, it'll often feel like this.

findings.description: Saber’s throat being slit or torn becomes her throat being crushed.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou minimizes his own condition against Saber having her throat cut open and being smashed into a wall.
findings.explanation: Saber’s throat being slit or torn becomes her throat being crushed.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは喉を裂かれ壁に叩きつけられた。
contexts.english: Saber got her throat crushed and was smashed against a wall.

findings.description: The recollection drops both the hammer-like force of Kuzuki's blow and its impact on Rin's chest, leaving only an unspecified blow.
findings.sourceReading: Rin coughed after taking Kuzuki's hammer-like blow to her chest.
findings.explanation: The recollection drops both the hammer-like force of Kuzuki's blow and its impact on Rin's chest, leaving only an unspecified blow.

contexts.japanese: あのハンマーみたいな葛木の一撃を胸に受けて
contexts.english: receiving that blow from Kuzuki.

findings.description: The numb half growing heavier becomes sensation itself getting stronger.
findings.sourceReading: Although he cannot feel the left side, Shirou thinks it is becoming heavy; the paradox deepens his concern.
findings.explanation: The numb half growing heavier becomes sensation itself getting stronger.

contexts.japanese: 感じないクセに重くなってきた気がする
contexts.english: the sensation is getting stronger, like everything is heavier.

findings.description: Releasing a sensation becomes removing a nerve. The English makes the description more concrete, though the magical context does not require literal anatomical extraction.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou disengages the sensation embedded in his spine, after which circuit-related tension releases.
findings.explanation: Releasing a sensation becomes removing a nerve. The English makes the description more concrete, though the magical context does not require literal anatomical extraction.

contexts.japanese: 背骨に抉り込んだ感覚を外す。
contexts.english: I remove the nerve I gouged into my spine.

findings.description: Archer’s diagnosis of movements displaced about seven centimeters inward is recast as displacement from Shirou’s center.
findings.sourceReading: The numb side’s movements are shifted roughly seven centimeters toward the inside relative to where Shirou intends them.
findings.explanation: Archer’s diagnosis of movements displaced about seven centimeters inward is recast as displacement from Shirou’s center.

contexts.japanese: 動作が中よりに七センチほどずれている
contexts.english: your movements are seven centimeters off from your center

findings.description: The renewed needle-like pain is turned into a literal needle stabbing Shirou’s back.
findings.sourceReading: The earlier sensation likened to a needle returns a second time when Archer touches his back; no physical needle has been introduced.
findings.explanation: The renewed needle-like pain is turned into a literal needle stabbing Shirou’s back.

contexts.japanese: もう一度、背中に鍼が刺さる。
contexts.english: The needle stabs my back again.

findings.description: Archer’s compressed claim that the same process once cost him an arm is made into an apparently literal removal of the limb.
findings.sourceReading: Archer says that at first an arm was “taken” from him, a phrase that can describe losing the arm’s use or suffering severe damage without settling the exact event here.
findings.explanation: Archer’s compressed claim that the same process once cost him an arm is made into an apparently literal removal of the limb.

contexts.japanese: 私も初めは片腕をもっていかれた。
contexts.english: I also had one of my arms taken away when I did it for the first time.

findings.description: Incomplete magical replenishment becomes no replenishment under any degree of restraint.
findings.sourceReading: Sleep can suppress consumption, but replenishment cannot be made fully adequate.
findings.explanation: Incomplete magical replenishment becomes no replenishment under any degree of restraint.

contexts.japanese: 魔力の補充は万全とはいかないらしい。
contexts.english: she can't replenish it no matter how much she limits herself.

findings.description: Becoming a circuit changes to making a circuit. This loses the explicit identification of practitioner and conduit, although the surrounding discussion still preserves self-erasure.
findings.sourceReading: The practitioner suppresses the self and becomes a circuit, paralleling the self-emptying discipline of archery.
findings.explanation: Becoming a circuit changes to making a circuit. This loses the explicit identification of practitioner and conduit, although the surrounding discussion still preserves self-erasure.

contexts.japanese: 自己を消して一つの『回路』になる事
contexts.english: erase oneself to make a circuit

findings.description: The sword arising in an empty mind loses the emptiness that frames the image.
findings.sourceReading: As he begins meditation, the familiar sword image surfaces in his emptied mind.
findings.explanation: The sword arising in an empty mind loses the emptiness that frames the image.

contexts.japanese: 空っぽの頭に浮かび上がる剣の姿。
contexts.english: An image of a sword that comes to mind.

findings.description: The need to empty his thoughts enough to forget all hesitation becomes a statement that he already forgets everything.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says immersion can make the war, Saber, and Rin disappear, and that he must reach thoughtlessness sufficient to forget his immature doubts.
findings.explanation: The need to empty his thoughts enough to forget all hesitation becomes a statement that he already forgets everything.

contexts.japanese: 未熟な自分の迷いを一切忘れるほど思考を無にしなくてはならない。
contexts.english: I forget all about the Holy Grail War, Saber, and Tohsaka once I immerse myself into the process.

findings.description: The imperfect realization of the Third Magic becomes an incomplete body.
findings.sourceReading: Rin wonders whether Illya’s Third Magic was incomplete or failed to reach the original form; this explains the initially unusual soul-vessel result.
findings.explanation: The imperfect realization of the Third Magic becomes an incomplete body.

contexts.japanese: それも不完全だったというか、イリヤの第三魔法はやっぱりオリジナルには届かなかった
contexts.english: it was an incomplete body, so Illya's Third Magic wasn't on the same level as the original

findings.description: Shirou’s ordinary growth and death at the end of his lifespan become growth and death at any time, omitting the normal-lifespan point.
findings.sourceReading: His new embodiment ages, grows, and will die naturally when his lifespan is exhausted, establishing that he is not immortal.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s ordinary growth and death at the end of his lifespan become growth and death at any time, omitting the normal-lifespan point.

contexts.japanese: 成長もするし、寿命を迎えれば天に召される
contexts.english: He'll grow, he'll go to Heaven when he dies

findings.description: Disrupted balance becomes losing one’s grip on reality.
findings.sourceReading: He hopes apparent spatial distortion comes from tension upsetting his sense of balance.
findings.explanation: Disrupted balance becomes losing one’s grip on reality.

contexts.japanese: 極度の緊張からくる平衡感覚の乱れ
contexts.english: losing my grip on reality due to extreme distress.

findings.description: The Shadow’s lack of three-dimensionality disappears.
findings.sourceReading: It is flat as if a shadow itself stood upright.
findings.explanation: The Shadow’s lack of three-dimensionality disappears.

contexts.japanese: 影がそのまま直立したような立体感のなさ
contexts.english: The Shadow stands there, upright and ethereal.

findings.description: A conjecture that the Shadow is not alive becomes categorical.
findings.sourceReading: おそらく marks an assessment, not established ontology.
findings.explanation: A conjecture that the Shadow is not alive becomes categorical.

contexts.japanese: おそらく生物でさえあり得まい
contexts.english: It isn't even a living creature.

findings.description: Rin's report that the strange entity vanished becomes a report that Shirou vanished. The Japanese exchange concerns what happened to the entity after he collapsed.
findings.sourceReading: Answering Shirou's question about the strange entity, Rin says it disappeared as he stood on its shadow and collapsed.
findings.explanation: Rin's report that the strange entity vanished becomes a report that Shirou vanished. The Japanese exchange concerns what happened to the entity after he collapsed.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮くんが影の上に立って、倒れたと思ったらもういなかった
contexts.english: You stepped on the shadow, and I thought you fell, but you were just gone.

findings.description: Softening tissue, melting below the neck, and removing bones are weakened to seepage, flow, and limpness.
findings.sourceReading: 柔らかくふやかしていく, 溶かされて, and 骨が抜かれていた continue bodily dissolution beyond general fluid entry.
findings.explanation: Softening tissue, melting below the neck, and removing bones are weakened to seepage, flow, and limpness.

contexts.japanese: 骨を、筋肉を、皮膚を柔らかくふやかしていく
contexts.english: It seeps into my bones, muscles, and skin.

contexts.japanese: 首から下もどんどんと溶かされて
contexts.english: It flows down from my neck

contexts.japanese: 骨が抜かれていた
contexts.english: turning it limp.

findings.description: Only moans escaping his melted throat becomes inability even to moan.
findings.sourceReading: 呻きしか漏れない excludes every sound except moaning; his throat has already melted.
findings.explanation: Only moans escaping his melted throat becomes inability even to moan.

contexts.japanese: 喉はもう溶けて、呻きしか漏れない
contexts.english: It floods my throat, and I can't even moan.

findings.description: Self-destruction and self-torment become inevitable decay.
findings.sourceReading: 自滅自虐 emphasizes the consequence turning against the violator itself, immediately followed by its anguished soundless crying.
findings.explanation: Self-destruction and self-torment become inevitable decay.

contexts.japanese: 自滅自虐は避けられまい
contexts.english: subject to inevitable decay

findings.description: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.
findings.sourceReading: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み is one of Rin’s specific remembered hardships.
findings.explanation: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.

contexts.japanese: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み
contexts.english: the Magic Crest engraved in her arm.

findings.description: The previously folded-back forearm with its palm sewn at the shoulder loses the folded arrangement.
findings.sourceReading: 肘から折り畳まれ、その掌を肩に置いた状態 explains why the elbow looked like the arm’s end and the hand was invisible.
findings.explanation: The previously folded-back forearm with its palm sewn at the shoulder loses the folded arrangement.

contexts.japanese: 肘から折り畳まれ、その掌を肩に置いた状態で縫い付けられていた腕
contexts.english: It bends into a grotesque forearm and hand that seems sewn into his shoulder.

findings.description: Shadow already extended to the waist becomes reaching for the waist.
findings.sourceReading: 腰まで伸びた names the attained height as the surrounding narration says it is already becoming her.
findings.explanation: Shadow already extended to the waist becomes reaching for the waist.

contexts.japanese: 腰まで伸びた影
contexts.english: reaches for her waist.

findings.description: The English omits the final surge of pain before the marks disappear. It preserves their disappearance and the following explanation that Shirou has lost his qualification as a Master.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's left hand hurts especially strongly before the disappearance. The following sentences explicitly identify the Command Spells as disappearing; the immediate subject of 消えた need not be forced.
findings.explanation: The English omits the final surge of pain before the marks disappear. It preserves their disappearance and the following explanation that Shirou has lost his qualification as a Master.

contexts.japanese: 一際強く左手が痛み、消えた
contexts.english: The pain in my left hand is gone.

findings.description: Back abrasions become bruising.
findings.sourceReading: 擦り傷 specifies scraped skin, later visibly scratched all over and treated topically.
findings.explanation: Back abrasions become bruising.

contexts.japanese: 背中の傷は擦り傷だろう
contexts.english: my back is probably bruised.

findings.description: Weight clinging to the moving ankles gains a twisting-ankle event.
findings.sourceReading: 重いモノが足枷となってまとわりつく describes fettering weight around the ankles he tries to move.
findings.explanation: Weight clinging to the moving ankles gains a twisting-ankle event.

contexts.japanese: 重いモノが足枷となってまとわりつく
contexts.english: my ankles twist, caught on something heavy like shackles.

findings.description: Discoloring fingernails scratching his throat become nails scratching the throat red.
findings.sourceReading: 喉を掻き毟る爪が変色している makes the claws/nails the thing changing color in the heat.
findings.explanation: Discoloring fingernails scratching his throat become nails scratching the throat red.

contexts.japanese: 喉を掻き毟る爪が変色している
contexts.english: my nails scratching it red.

findings.description: Limbs wanting rest after a short walk gain breathlessness as the cause of collapse.
findings.sourceReading: 手足は休息を欲しがって describes bodily exhaustion despite only going to the veranda.
findings.explanation: Limbs wanting rest after a short walk gain breathlessness as the cause of collapse.

contexts.japanese: 手足は休息を欲しがってすぐに倒れてしまう
contexts.english: the effort made me so short of breath I collapsed right back into bed.

findings.description: Stimulation while consciousness is transferred becomes stimulation before the transfer is done.
findings.sourceReading: 意識が転移先に移っている最中 covers the period it is at its destination, with bodily stimulus forcing recall.
findings.explanation: Stimulation while consciousness is transferred becomes stimulation before the transfer is done.

contexts.japanese: 意識が転移先に移っている最中
contexts.english: before the transfer is done

findings.description: Pain failing to stop him becomes pain driving him into flight.
findings.sourceReading: 痛みで止まらねえんなら explains why a disabling cut would have been preferable: pain does not immobilize him.
findings.explanation: Pain failing to stop him becomes pain driving him into flight.

contexts.japanese: 痛みで止まらねえんなら
contexts.english: if I'd known the pain would drive him into flight.

findings.description: Cutting at limb roots becomes severing limbs.
findings.sourceReading: 手足の付け根、大動脈を斬りつければ names cuts at limb junctions and major arteries.
findings.explanation: Cutting at limb roots becomes severing limbs.

contexts.japanese: 手足の付け根、大動脈を斬りつければ
contexts.english: the severing of one's limbs or major arteries

findings.description: Disabling the limbs acquires an all-four requirement.
findings.sourceReading: 四肢の無力化 is limb disablement in contrast with bleeding; the next example considers disabling a single arm.
findings.explanation: Disabling the limbs acquires an all-four requirement.

contexts.japanese: これが四肢の無力化になると話は別だが
contexts.english: if one were to cripple all four limbs

findings.description: A left-thigh strike becomes cleaving from the left hip.
findings.sourceReading: 左足大腿部 identifies the left thigh as his aimed strike, interrupted by his retreat.
findings.explanation: A left-thigh strike becomes cleaving from the left hip.

contexts.japanese: 水蜘蛛の左足大腿部を一閃しかけ
contexts.english: cleave the fleeing water strider from the left hip

findings.description: Physical depletion becomes despondency.
findings.sourceReading: 眠気にも似た虚脱感 follows reconsideration of bodily recovery and motivates resting, then lethargic bedding preparation.
findings.explanation: Physical depletion becomes despondency.

contexts.japanese: 眠気にも似た虚脱感
contexts.english: a sense of despondency that feels similar to drowsiness.

findings.description: A fiery whip becomes a red-hot rod.
findings.sourceReading: 背骨に差し込まれた炎の鞭 gives a whip-of-fire bodily circuit image being withdrawn.
findings.explanation: A fiery whip becomes a red-hot rod.

contexts.japanese: 炎の鞭
contexts.english: the red-hot rod

findings.description: Mirror polishing retains erosion but loses clouding.
findings.sourceReading: 磨かれ曇り combines polishing and becoming clouded before progressive wearing away, part of the contradictory dream imagery.
findings.explanation: Mirror polishing retains erosion but loses clouding.

contexts.japanese: 鏡のように磨かれ曇り
contexts.english: polished to a mirror-like shine while it erodes away.

findings.description: Grasping the arm’s cloth becomes grasping the arm.
findings.sourceReading: His right hand grips the wrapping on the left arm, relevant to Illya’s warning against removing it.
findings.explanation: Grasping the arm’s cloth becomes grasping the arm.

contexts.japanese: 右手が左腕の布を掴んでいる
contexts.english: my right hand is grabbing my left arm.

findings.description: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.
findings.sourceReading: She had proposed installing a circuit switch and now cancels that plan because making easy on/off possible would endanger him.
findings.explanation: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.

contexts.japanese: この前は士郎の体にスイッチをいれようって言ってたけど、アレは止めるわ
contexts.english: You've talked about flipping a switch in your body before, but don't do that this time.

contexts.japanese: ここで簡単に魔術回路の開閉ができるようになったら
contexts.english: You'll be in danger if you open and close your Magic Circuits carelessly.

findings.description: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.
findings.sourceReading: 腹に当てられた手 is current abdominal contact, already hard to bear; a small rodlike object passes through skin into his body.
findings.explanation: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.

contexts.japanese: 腹に当てられた遠坂の手の平だけでも耐えられない
contexts.english: Tohsaka's palm on my chest was unbearable enough, but now something small and stick-like is under my skin, digging around inside my body...!

findings.description: A posture instruction becomes a resilience idiom.
findings.sourceReading: 胸張って tells him to hold his chest out for the shoulder stage of the procedure.
findings.explanation: A posture instruction becomes a resilience idiom.

contexts.japanese: ちゃんと胸張ってよ
contexts.english: Come on, suck it up.

findings.description: The English omits the gallbladder from the organ list. The surrounding account of extensive internal injury remains.
findings.sourceReading: The compressed bodily inventory explicitly includes the gallbladder after the liver.
findings.explanation: The English omits the gallbladder from the organ list. The surrounding account of extensive internal injury remains.

contexts.japanese: 肝臓胆嚢　大腸八器
contexts.english: liver, and all eight sections of my large intestine.

findings.description: Head pressed to tatami becomes head tucked into his stomach.
findings.sourceReading: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま maintains contact with the floor after the actual head impact in11.
findings.explanation: Head pressed to tatami becomes head tucked into his stomach.

contexts.japanese: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま
contexts.english: tuck my head into my stomach

findings.description: Awareness fragmenting becomes a mental ordeal.
findings.sourceReading: 意識がボロボロと欠けた describes disintegrating consciousness after only slight loosening and shoulder exposure.
findings.explanation: Awareness fragmenting becomes a mental ordeal.

contexts.japanese: 意識がボロボロと欠けた
contexts.english: was enough of mental ordeal.

findings.description: Forgetting how to look back one second becomes forgetting how he felt then.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot recall the METHOD of directing his thought one second backward, not merely the contents of a feeling.
findings.explanation: Forgetting how to look back one second becomes forgetting how he felt then.

contexts.japanese: 一秒前に思いを馳せる、という方法が思い出せなかった
contexts.english: I can't remember how I was feeling just a second ago.

findings.description: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.
findings.sourceReading: 人の手が入りまくった頭 describes his mind having other people’s intervention throughout, echoing invasive/cooking reconstruction imagery.
findings.explanation: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.

contexts.japanese: お節介なまでに人の手が入りまくった頭
contexts.english: My useless head, that only knows how to help other people so much it's a nuisance

findings.description: A more vigorous blood flow becomes brighter blood.
findings.sourceReading: 景気よく qualifies the amount/strength of blood emerging.
findings.explanation: A more vigorous blood flow becomes brighter blood.

contexts.japanese: 思ったより景気よく血が出てくる
contexts.english: Blood leaks out, brighter than I expected.

findings.description: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.
findings.sourceReading: The two sides are separately assigned pain/fear and pleasure/loss; 喪失 supplies depletion alongside sensation.
findings.explanation: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.

contexts.japanese: 左手は苦痛と恐怖に、右手は快感と喪失に
contexts.english: the discomfort and fear of my left arm is drowned out by the pleasure in my right.

findings.description: Being bedridden for life becomes sleeping forever.
findings.sourceReading: 一生寝たきり follows possible inability to use limbs; she could accept bodily disability but not loss of self.
findings.explanation: Being bedridden for life becomes sleeping forever.

contexts.japanese: 手足がきかなくなって、一生寝たきりでも怖くはない
contexts.english: She isn't afraid of falling asleep forever.

findings.description: The bowl is no longer identified as having held porridge, making the trace of sickroom care less specific. Shirou still infers that he visited Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: An emptied porridge dish, Sakura's pajamas, and a wet towel lead Shirou to infer that he visited her earlier.
findings.explanation: The bowl is no longer identified as having held porridge, making the trace of sickroom care less specific. Shirou still infers that he visited Sakura.

contexts.japanese: カラになった粥の皿
contexts.english: an empty bowl

findings.description: Pain that could blind becomes pain of going blind.
findings.sourceReading: 失明しかねない qualifies the potential severity of numbing pain.
findings.explanation: Pain that could blind becomes pain of going blind.

contexts.japanese: 失明しかねない麻痺痛
contexts.english: The numb pain of going blind

findings.description: An eruption compared more to an explosion than to water becomes a geyser of water. The violent image survives, but the source's contrast disappears.
findings.sourceReading: The red eruption suggests an explosion more than a discharge of water.
findings.explanation: An eruption compared more to an explosion than to water becomes a geyser of water. The violent image survives, but the source's contrast disappears.

contexts.japanese: 吹き出す赤は、放水より爆発を思わせる
contexts.english: The gushing red reminds me of a sudden geyser of water.

findings.description: The self standing still becomes a stopped self.
findings.sourceReading: 立ち止まる自分 means the present self hesitating/standing at the decision.
findings.explanation: The self standing still becomes a stopped self.

contexts.japanese: 立ち止まる自分の胸を打つ
contexts.english: hammer my stopped self in the chest.

findings.description: Remembering how she came to sleep beside him becomes remembering only that they slept together.
findings.sourceReading: 経緯 identifies the circumstances/process leading to her being next to him, which alone he retains amid identity failure.
findings.explanation: Remembering how she came to sleep beside him becomes remembering only that they slept together.

contexts.japanese: 隣で桜が眠っている経緯だけは憶えている
contexts.english: all I remember is that we went to sleep next to each other.

findings.description: Lost time when trying to think becomes getting lost in thought.
findings.sourceReading: 深く考えようとすると十秒後の世界にいる describes finding himself ten seconds further on when attempting thought.
findings.explanation: Lost time when trying to think becomes getting lost in thought.

contexts.japanese: 深く考えようとすると十秒後の世界にいる
contexts.english: I end up getting lost in thought for ten seconds.

findings.description: Possible current activities become a completed sequence of all four chores.

findings.description: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura performs an act that seems liable to shred the nerves throughout her body, while remaining outwardly cool.
findings.explanation: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.

contexts.japanese: 自らの身体を抉り、全身の神経がズタズタになりそうな行為を、少女は涼しげに笑いながらやってのけた。
contexts.english: The girl gouges out her own body, tearing her own nerves to shreds, all while giggling coolly.

findings.description: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.
findings.sourceReading: At this moment portions throughout his body are dying, in ongoing erasure.
findings.explanation: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.

contexts.japanese: いや、この瞬間、体のいたるところが死んでいる。
contexts.english: No, in this moment, every part of my body is dead.

findings.description: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.
findings.sourceReading: Right lung is cut or torn open from within.
findings.explanation: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.

contexts.japanese: 右の肺が、内側から切り裂かれた。
contexts.english: My right lung is torn out from inside.

findings.description: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: Stripped of objective/subjective orientation, he is ruled by unfamiliar perception.
findings.explanation: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 客観と主観を剥ぎ取られ、未知の知覚に支配される。
contexts.english: The objective and subjective are stripped away. Unknown knowledge dominates me.

findings.description: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Body is beyond saving, but stopping now might preserve meaningful selfhood for about a day; the next line calls this one-day life extension.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.
findings.sourceReading: An internal crack is located specifically in 大脳の側座核, with motivation/pleasure gloss following.
findings.explanation: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.
findings.sourceReading: Even the pain of loss cannot halt disappearing memories.
findings.explanation: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.

contexts.japanese: 失み欠う苦痛も、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

findings.description: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.
findings.sourceReading: Fortunately he does not suffer, because sensation has nearly turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.

contexts.japanese: 幸い、苦しいなんて事はなかった。
contexts.english: I don't feel happiness or suffering.

findings.description: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.
findings.sourceReading: Most of his senses have turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.

contexts.japanese: 五感は、そのほとんどが鉄になっている。
contexts.english: My five senses have already turned to iron.

findings.description: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Stopping now could preserve meaningful selfhood for about one day although body is already beyond saving; next calls it one-day extension.
findings.explanation: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.
findings.sourceReading: Internal crack specifically affects 大脳の側座核, followed by motivation/pleasure gloss.
findings.explanation: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.
findings.sourceReading: Even pain from biting fingers of right hand cannot stop disappearing memory.
findings.explanation: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.

contexts.japanese: 右手の指を食べる痛みも、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

contexts.japanese: 自分が自分のままでいる事に、指を食うほど執着している。
contexts.english: I bite my fingers to remind myself that I'm still me.

findings.description: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.
findings.sourceReading: Sky is just a little farther, reachable merely by extending arm, before he realizes there is no power left and sinks.
findings.explanation: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.

contexts.japanese: ほんの少し、ただ腕を伸ばすだけで、空へ抜ける。
contexts.english: For just a moment, I lift my arm up and reach into the sky.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が救ってくれた命が、沈んでいく。
contexts.english: The life she saved is sinking.

contexts.japanese: 手を伸ばす。
contexts.english: I reach out.

findings.description: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.
findings.sourceReading: 気が遠くなる describes consciousness receding/faintness while he still moves, speaks and projects before self disappears.
findings.explanation: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.

contexts.japanese: ……気が遠くなる。
contexts.english: ...I lose consciousness.

contexts.japanese: 自分が無くなる前に、前へ。
contexts.english: Before I'm gone, I need to go forward.

findings.description: Right leg becomes left leg.
findings.sourceReading: Shadow strikes target shoulder, chest, right leg and abdomen; the next line explicitly denies penetration.
findings.explanation: Right leg becomes left leg.

contexts.japanese: 肩と胸、右足と腹に影が突き刺さる。
contexts.english: Shadows strike at my shoulder, chest, left leg, and stomach.

contexts.japanese: 影は突き刺さらず、火花をこぼしてズレていく。
contexts.english: They get deflected and fail to pierce me, throwing up a shower of sparks.

findings.description: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.
findings.sourceReading: Only through that obsession he still remains in this world.
findings.explanation: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.

contexts.japanese: ただ、その執念だけで、未だこの世に留まっていた。
contexts.english: Only its obsession is still intact.

contexts.japanese: マキリ臓硯。魂をこの世に留める本体を潰された老魔術師は、その執念だけでこの世界に残留していた。
contexts.english: Zouken Makiri. The old mage, his main body anchoring his soul having been crushed, clings to this world by his obsession alone.

findings.description: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.
findings.sourceReading: Base 剣 says sword while ruby てつ says iron/metal: only his face has not become sword/iron yet.
findings.explanation: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.

contexts.japanese: 顔だけはまだ剣になっていない。
contexts.english: My face alone hasn't turned to steel yet.

findings.description: Arm's frantic autonomous repair becomes Shirou working the arm.
findings.sourceReading: Left arm itself becomes frantic trying to repair his pulverized frame, causing whitening and mental erosion.
findings.explanation: Arm's frantic autonomous repair becomes Shirou working the arm.

contexts.japanese: それを修復しようと左腕が躍起になり、結果—
contexts.english: I work my left arm to try and repair it, and—

contexts.japanese: それは敵によるダメージではなく、傷ついた体を直し、書き換えようとする、左腕からの痛みだった。
contexts.english: It isn't the damage from his attacks, but from the pain of my left arm repairing and overwriting my injured body.

findings.description: Consciousness becomes memories.
findings.sourceReading: Both visual images and consciousness become white beyond return.
findings.explanation: Consciousness becomes memories.

contexts.japanese: 映像も意識も、戻れないところまで白く。
contexts.english: Images and memories become irreturnably white.

findings.description: Left flank becomes left armpit.
findings.sourceReading: 左わき腹 is the left side/flank of the abdomen.
findings.explanation: Left flank becomes left armpit.

contexts.japanese: 同時に左わき腹に衝撃。脳を切りきざむ刃に堪えて、もう一撃。
contexts.english: There's a simultaneous impact to my left armpit. I endure the blades stabbing my brain and attack again.

findings.description: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.
findings.sourceReading: Heart is pressed from above chest while beating warning, before later wall-supported walking; exact hand/agent not independently specified.
findings.explanation: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.

contexts.japanese: 胸の上から押さえつけた心臓は、ずいぶん前から慌ただしく危険信号を送っている。
contexts.english: Her heart's been drumming a warning signal for some time from within the confines of her chest.

findings.description: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.
findings.sourceReading: Black mud from core/interior of body coats skin.
findings.explanation: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.

contexts.japanese: 体の芯から、黒い泥が肌を塗りたくっていく。
contexts.english: Starting with her feet, the black mud coats her skin.

findings.description: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.
findings.sourceReading: His paralysis is not because he was overwhelmed by her enormous magical energy; the next sentences identify her intent to kill him as its cause.
findings.explanation: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.

contexts.japanese: その膨大すぎる魔力に呑まれた訳じゃない。
contexts.english: I haven't been swallowed by this titanic magical energy yet.

contexts.japanese: 体を凍らせるのはただ一つ。
contexts.english: There's only one reason I can't move:

contexts.japanese: 桜は本気で—俺に、殺意を向けていた。
contexts.english: Sakura's boundless bloodlust is directed at me.

findings.description: Lead-heavy whole-body impairment disappears during renewed pursuit.
findings.sourceReading: His whole body feels like lead, and nausea/chills make his brain spin, as he chases the girls.
findings.explanation: Lead-heavy whole-body impairment disappears during renewed pursuit.

contexts.japanese: 全身鉛、吐き気と悪寒で脳みそがぐるんぐるんの状態で、遠ざかっていく二人を追いかける。
contexts.english: I chase after them with reckless abandon, pushing through the nausea, the chill, and my soup-like brain.

findings.description: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.
findings.sourceReading: She experiences a tinnitus/ringing that writhes within her body; pathological internal sound image.
findings.explanation: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.

contexts.japanese: 体内で蠢く耳鳴りがする。
contexts.english: All their squirming in her body starts to make her ears ring.

findings.description: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.
findings.sourceReading: Body stumbles over dark longing, falls immediately and abjectly clings to ground.
findings.explanation: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.

contexts.japanese: 体は昏い恋しさに躓いてすぐに倒れ、卑しく地面にすがりつく。
contexts.english: The dark longing makes her stumble, and she tumbles to the ground in a tangle of hair and limbs.

findings.description: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.
findings.sourceReading: Spine poignantly melts like viscous matter.
findings.explanation: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.

contexts.japanese: 止まらない呼吸、粘体のように切なく融ける脊椎。
contexts.english: She can't stop breathing. Her spine fuses together like sticky sap.

findings.description: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.
findings.sourceReading: When focus slips she no longer knows what she had been doing; memories vague, limb sensations gone and subjective day fragmented.
findings.explanation: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.

contexts.japanese: 今はちゃんとしてるけど、気を抜くとね、自分が何をしていたか分からなくなるの。……日に日に記憶が曖昧になって、手足の感覚もない。時間の感覚だってもうバラバラで、一日が長く続いてくれないんだ。
contexts.english: I'm still myself now, but if I lose focus, I don't know what I'll do... My memories are getting more vague each day, and I can't feel my arms and legs anymore. My sense of time is all over the place, and I can't even keep track of a day anymore.

findings.description: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.
findings.sourceReading: A lot happened yesterday, but he thinks fatigue isn't due to last night's events, with embarrassed hesitation.
findings.explanation: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.

contexts.japanese: たしかに昨日は色々あったが、別に、その、昨夜のことで疲れたワケじゃないと思う。
contexts.english: A lot happened yesterday, but I didn't go to bed particularly exhausted.

findings.description: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.
findings.sourceReading: He supposes sluggishness from shallow/light sleep.
findings.explanation: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.

contexts.japanese: この気だるさは眠りが浅かったせいだろう。
contexts.english: I probably feel this way because I didn't sleep enough.

findings.description: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Black armor passes through greatsword and debris, then flashes a cut across the exposed body.
findings.explanation: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.

contexts.japanese: 吹き荒ぶ風の元凶はあの黒い剣士なのか、黒い甲冑はバーサーカーの大剣と土塊をすり抜け、無防備な体を一閃する。
contexts.english: The black-armored Servant breezes past Berserker's greatsword and earthen assault, as if it's the source of this raging wind.

contexts.japanese: それを、黒い剣士は苦もなく切断する。
contexts.english: And the black swordsman easily slices it open.

findings.description: A darkness-swallowing-light simile becomes inky light threatening to swallow Berserker whole.
findings.sourceReading: The sword paints Berserker's flank black like light swallowed by lightless darkness.
findings.explanation: A darkness-swallowing-light simile becomes inky light threatening to swallow Berserker whole.

contexts.japanese: 無明の闇が光を呑むように、剣はバーサーカーの横腹を黒で塗りつぶしていった。
contexts.english: A sword paints Berserker's flank in black, the inky light threatening to swallow him whole.

findings.description: Charging through the knee-deep Shadow becomes already free of it after waist-deep engulfment.
findings.sourceReading: Berserker charges while scattering the black Shadow in which he is sunk to his knees.
findings.explanation: Charging through the knee-deep Shadow becomes already free of it after waist-deep engulfment.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーは地面を、膝まで沈みこんだ黒い影を蹴散らしながら突進する。
contexts.english: Berserker kicks his way out of the ground, free of the black Shadow that had swallowed him up to the waist, and charges.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーを封じているのは足元の沼だけでなく、黒い影は全身に絡みついて巨人を縛している。
contexts.english: Not only was he being constricted by the mud at his feet. The Shadow also had him entirely bound.

contexts.japanese: 故に、巨人はその身を裂いた。
contexts.english: So he decided to tear himself free.

findings.description: Grabbing his own chest becomes grabbing the attached Shadow.
findings.sourceReading: The giant grasps his chest and rips away the black Shadow together with his adhering flesh.
findings.explanation: Grabbing his own chest becomes grabbing the attached Shadow.

contexts.japanese: 片手で胸を掴み、バリ、という音をたてて、黒い影を引き剥がした。
contexts.english: With one hand, he grabbed the Shadow that latched to his chest and tore it off with a ripping sound.

contexts.japanese: —絡みついた部分ごと、中身が覗こうという勢いで、自らの身体を剥いだのだ。
contexts.english: —He literally tore his body open wherever the Shadow had grabbed him, exposing his innards.

findings.description: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.
findings.sourceReading: Illya vaguely realizes escape from her fear is impossible, and the narration then states that Berserker stops.
findings.explanation: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.

contexts.japanese: この不安、恐怖からは逃げられない、と少女は漠然と悟り—黒い巨人は足を止めた。
contexts.english: Vaguely realizing that there's no escape from this dread, from this fear, the girl orders the dark giant to stop.

findings.description: The forest's present death becomes a future prediction.
findings.sourceReading: As the Shadow surges and drains surrounding magical energy, the forest dies.
findings.explanation: The forest's present death becomes a future prediction.

contexts.japanese: 森が死ぬ。
contexts.english: This forest will die.

contexts.japanese: 周囲にある全ての魔力があの影に吸われていく。
contexts.english: All of the surrounding mana is being sucked into the Shadow.

findings.description: Perception becomes spirit.
findings.sourceReading: The burst dyes Shirou's field of vision and perception entirely black as he covers Illya.
findings.explanation: Perception becomes spirit.

contexts.japanese: 視界と知覚が、黒一色に染め上げられた。
contexts.english: my sight and spirit are dyed jet black.

findings.description: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing clear blackness makes him wonder whether a black sun has fallen/come down.
findings.explanation: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.

contexts.japanese: こんなにハッキリ見えているのに暗いってコトは、黒い太陽でも落ちてきたのか。
contexts.english: It's so dark, even though I can see clearly. I must have fallen into a black sun.

findings.description: Loss of touch becomes loss of every sense.
findings.sourceReading: Absence of tactile sensation feels more revolting than pain.
findings.explanation: Loss of touch becomes loss of every sense.

contexts.japanese: 痛みより、触覚がない喪失感が気色悪い。
contexts.english: The complete sensory loss is more revolting than any pain.

findings.description: The sizzling instant of the left-side disappearance vanishes.
findings.sourceReading: Everything beyond left shoulder disappears cleanly with a brief sizzling sound.
findings.explanation: The sizzling instant of the left-side disappearance vanishes.

contexts.japanese: じゅっ、と音をたててキレイさっぱり消え去った。
contexts.english: It's all gone.

findings.description: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.
findings.sourceReading: After the burst, the black Shadow melts away without trace, perhaps having exhausted its power.
findings.explanation: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.

contexts.japanese: ……消えていく。
contexts.english: ...I'm disappearing.

contexts.japanese: 今ので力を使い果たしたのか、“黒い影”は跡形もなく溶けていった。
contexts.english: The Shadow melts away without a trace, as if it's expended all its power.

findings.description: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.
findings.sourceReading: Through stress-numbed hearing come Berserker's roar, strong wind noise, and an explosive sound so great it overwhelms even vision.
findings.explanation: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.

contexts.japanese: 視覚すら覆うほどの、爆音が流れ込んだ。
contexts.english: buffet me so violently I can't even see.

contexts.japanese: ……緊張で麻痺した耳には、狂戦士の咆哮と、強い風鳴りと、
contexts.english: ...In my ears gone numb from stress, the fierce howling of the wind and the mad warrior's roars

findings.description: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.
findings.sourceReading: During red vertigo Shirou feels as though a long blade enters at the shoulder and grinds/stirs violently around inside his body.
findings.explanation: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.

contexts.japanese: この赤い目眩が起きるたび、肩から長い刃物を突き刺され、体ん中をギチギチとかき回される錯覚がする。
contexts.english: Every time the red vertigo comes, I feel a long blade stab me in the shoulder, and I almost think I hear grinding sounds inside my body.

findings.description: Iron becomes steel in Shirou's denial about the arm.
findings.sourceReading: As part of his tempting rationalization, Shirou insists his arm is certainly not iron.
findings.explanation: Iron becomes steel in Shirou's denial about the arm.

contexts.japanese: 俺の腕は決して鉄なんかじゃない。
contexts.english: It can't possibly be made of steel.

findings.description: Actually undoing the cloth becomes merely trying to undo it.
findings.sourceReading: On impulse Shirou removes/undoes the cloth for an instant, experiences the fragmented recoil, and rewinds it.
findings.explanation: Actually undoing the cloth becomes merely trying to undo it.

contexts.japanese: 一瞬、思いつきのまま布を解いた。
contexts.english: For a second, I tried undoing the cloth wrap.

findings.description: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou orders himself that an arm not moving is nothing serious and to think about something else.
findings.explanation: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.

contexts.japanese: 「……大丈夫だ。ただ腕が動かないだけで、どうって事はない。悩むならもっと別のことを考えろ」
contexts.english: "...It'll be okay. I can't move the arm, but I still have options. There's plenty of other stuff to worry about."

findings.description: Shirou gripping his immobile left arm becomes trying to clench the immobile left hand.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou uses his other hand to grip/clutch the left arm that will not move.
findings.explanation: Shirou gripping his immobile left arm becomes trying to clench the immobile left hand.

contexts.japanese: ……動かない左腕を握り締める。
contexts.english: ...I try to clench my unmoving left hand.

findings.description: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.
findings.sourceReading: Uneven ground shelters Shirou in a hollow: the Shadow passes around/avoids him, except for the exposed left arm.
findings.explanation: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 広がった黒い影は窪みにいた衛宮士郎を避けて通った。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya evaded the Shadow in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 森の地面が凹凸だった事が幸いしたのだ。
contexts.english: He was fortunate that the forest terrain is filled with crags and valleys.

findings.description: Slightly controlling the foreign element becomes controlling the pain.
findings.sourceReading: Once Shirou identifies the foreign body's source, he can exert some control over it and build a barrier preventing mixture with his core body.
findings.explanation: Slightly controlling the foreign element becomes controlling the pain.

contexts.japanese: 痛みの元、異物がなんであるか判れば多少はコントロールできる。
contexts.english: If I know the source of the pain, the foreign element, then I can slightly control the pain.

findings.description: Dreaming inside a breeding box becomes dreaming about one.
findings.sourceReading: The opening says the subject dreams in a rearing/breeding box; page2 deliberately shifts to dreaming of the box.
findings.explanation: Dreaming inside a breeding box becomes dreaming about one.

contexts.japanese: 飼育箱で夢を見る。
contexts.english: I dream of a box for breeding bugs.

findings.description: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she can no longer perform the feat of reviving someone near death; Shirou himself somehow dealt with his scattered insides.
findings.explanation: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.

contexts.japanese: 「まさか。死にかけてる人間を蘇生させる、なんて芸当は、もうわたしには出来ない。衛宮士郎は自分でぶっ飛んだ中身をどうにかしたのよ」

counterexamples.explanation: Rider tests recognition.

contexts.japanese: 「酷い顔色ですね。私が認識できますか、士郎」
contexts.english: "You look awful. Do you recognize me, Shirou?"

counterexamples.description: Circuits activate before any materialized weapon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He starts Magic Circuits while watching Rider.
counterexamples.explanation: Circuits activate before any materialized weapon.

contexts.japanese: ライダーを見据えたまま、魔術回路を立ち上げる。
contexts.english: I start up my Magic Circuits, keeping my eyes on Rider.

counterexamples.description: Self-command to remember retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After failing to retrieve what she asked, he commands himself to remember.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-command to remember retained.

contexts.japanese: 思い出せ。
contexts.english: Remember.

counterexamples.description: Pain cessation is deterioration, not recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Biological functions are being eroded.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain cessation is deterioration, not recovery.

contexts.japanese: 生物としての機能が少しずつこそぎ落ちているだけだ。
contexts.english: My functions as a living creature are just slowly being eroded.

counterexamples.description: Stopping threatens awareness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses track of what he is doing if he stops.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopping threatens awareness retained.

contexts.japanese: 立ち止まっていると、自分が何をしているか判らなくなる。
contexts.english: If I stop, I won't know what I'm doing.

counterexamples.description: Painful pendant is right-hand anchor.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He squeezes it tightly in his right hand to retain himself.
counterexamples.explanation: Painful pendant is right-hand anchor.

contexts.japanese: 右手に持ったペンダントを強く握る。
contexts.english: I grip the pendant tightly in my right hand.

counterexamples.description: Five more blows remain estimated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he can withstand five more, then cannot predict.
counterexamples.explanation: Five more blows remain estimated.

contexts.japanese: これならあと五回はセイバーの剣を受けられる。
contexts.english: I should be able to take five more of Saber's attacks.

counterexamples.description: Bloodlessness and sword innards do not prevent limit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber warns his body is still at its end despite those altered features.
counterexamples.explanation: Bloodlessness and sword innards do not prevent limit.

contexts.japanese: 「その体でよく吠える。……いえ、その体だからこそ無謀な策を強行する。いかに血が出ず、いかに中身が剣になろうと、貴方の肉体は限界だ。このまま打ち合えば、次はその剣ごと粉砕する」
contexts.english: "You would still howl that, with that body? ...No, you attempt such reckless ploys because of that very body. You may not bleed, and your innards may be made of swords, but your body is at its limit. If you continue this, my next strike will destroy you, swords and all."

counterexamples.description: Stopped-heart perception coexists with later living heartbeat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Collapsing first-person thought says heart had stopped; later actual beat remains in text.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopped-heart perception coexists with later living heartbeat.

contexts.japanese: いや、そんなもの数秒前から止まっていた。
contexts.english: No, it's been stopped for several seconds.

contexts.japanese: 心臓は動いている。
contexts.english: My heart is moving.

contexts.japanese: 少年の心臓は動いているし、呼吸もしている。
contexts.english: His heart is moving and he's breathing.

counterexamples.description: Self-awareness fractions retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Remaining awareness/self goes from forty to twenty percent, then ten.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-awareness fractions retained.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーの腕に意識を接続した瞬間、残っていた四割の意識が二割に減った。
contexts.english: As soon as I connect my consciousness to the arm, the remaining forty percent of my mind drops to twenty.

contexts.japanese: 残り一割。
contexts.english: Ten percent left.

counterexamples.description: Names of many things disappear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses object names and even his own.
counterexamples.explanation: Names of many things disappear.

contexts.japanese: 色々なものの名称が失われた。
contexts.english: I forget what so many things are called.

counterexamples.description: Saber’s name called at final strike.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cries the name despite progressive name loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber’s name called at final strike.

contexts.english: "SABERRR!!!"

counterexamples.description: Unresolved pride versus regret retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot decide how to judge final memory of her name.
counterexamples.explanation: Unresolved pride versus regret retained.

contexts.japanese: それが誇っていい事なのか、悔いるべき事なのか、今の自分には判らない。
contexts.english: I don't know if I should be proud that I remember, or regret it.

counterexamples.description: First-person defeat claim remains subjective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks enemy defeated and expects rest.
counterexamples.explanation: First-person defeat claim remains subjective.

contexts.japanese: ともあれ敵は倒した。
contexts.english: In any case, I defeated the enemy.

counterexamples.description: Living body despite absent person retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Heart beats, breath continues, open eyes stare while will is gone.
counterexamples.explanation: Living body despite absent person retained.

contexts.japanese: 少年の心臓は動いているし、呼吸もしている。
contexts.english: His heart is moving and he's breathing.

counterexamples.description: Current helplessness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Near-death from Shadow and lack of effective response still apply.
counterexamples.explanation: Current helplessness retained.

contexts.japanese: それは今も変わらない。
contexts.english: That hasn't changed.

counterexamples.description: Both have limited time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy's dizziness leads him to think Sakura is not the only one running out of time.
counterexamples.explanation: Both have limited time.

contexts.japanese: ……どうやら、時間がないのは桜だけじゃなさそうだ。
contexts.english: ...It seems that Sakura isn't the only one running out of time.

counterexamples.description: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya has not told Rin he already released the shroud.
counterexamples.explanation: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤ、遠坂には聖骸布を解いた事を言っていないんだ。
contexts.english: Illya hasn't told Tohsaka that I took off the holy shroud.

counterexamples.description: Likely guilt rather than certain intervention.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin probably will not stop him now but will feel responsible.
counterexamples.explanation: Likely guilt rather than certain intervention.

contexts.japanese: 事此処にいたって止めはしないだろうが、あいつは絶対に責任を感じる。
contexts.english: She probably wouldn't stop me, but she would definitely feel responsible.

counterexamples.description: Binding released after entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya unbinds left arm once he is inside and demands quick Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Binding released after entry.

contexts.japanese: ……シロウが中に入ったら、わたしが左腕の拘束を外す。二百年前の記録へ遡る圧力と、左腕の侵食が同時に来るわ。気をしっかり持って、出来るだけ早く投影を終わらせなさい」
contexts.english: ...Once you're inside, I'll unbind your left arm. Your arm is going to invade you at the same time while you travel two hundred years into history. Keep a firm grip on yourself and try to finish the Projection as quickly as you can."

counterexamples.description: Cause of distortion unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether sensory plunge or arm release causes the experience.
counterexamples.explanation: Cause of distortion unresolved.

contexts.japanese: それとも、左腕の拘束を外されたからか。
contexts.english: or because she undid the binding on my left arm?

counterexamples.description: Identity recognition fails.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not know who he is in the fragmented record experience.
counterexamples.explanation: Identity recognition fails.

contexts.japanese: 自分が判らない。
contexts.english: I don't know who I am.

counterexamples.description: Shrinkage belongs to experienced viewpoint.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Lower view from shrinking self makes world too large.
counterexamples.explanation: Shrinkage belongs to experienced viewpoint.

contexts.japanese: 縮んだ体、低くなった視界では世界が広すぎる。
contexts.english: From the lower perspective of my shrunken body, the world is far too big.

counterexamples.description: Reaching repetition retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Repeated reach lines enact continued effort with burning perception.
counterexamples.explanation: Reaching repetition retained.

contexts.japanese: 何十メートルと左手を伸ばして、伸ばして、伸ばして、伸ばして—
contexts.english: I reach out dozens of meters. I reach, reach, reach...

counterexamples.description: Risk of self-disappearance challenged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks whether he wants to fade away.
counterexamples.explanation: Risk of self-disappearance challenged.

contexts.japanese: 「諦めなさい……！　このまま消え去りたいのシロウ！」
contexts.english: "Give up! Do you want to fade away, Shirou!?"

counterexamples.description: Extended reach still fragmented.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Reach and repeated dashes continue across entries.
counterexamples.explanation: Extended reach still fragmented.

contexts.japanese: 届け—
contexts.english: Reach it—

counterexamples.description: Knife perception is delirious.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fragmented boy feels a huge kitchen-knife stab before recognizing Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Knife perception is delirious.

contexts.japanese: 横合いからでっかい包丁で刺された。
contexts.english: A huge kitchen knife stabs me in the side.

counterexamples.description: Pain used to preserve awareness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He clenches wounded hand around pendant to keep conscious.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain used to preserve awareness.

contexts.japanese: 右手を強く握って、ペンダントを裂けた肌の肉に突き刺して、意識を保つ。
contexts.english: I clench my right hand and let the pendant dig into my torn skin. It keeps me awake.

counterexamples.description: One-more estimate is self-assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he can manage roughly one further Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: One-more estimate is self-assessment.

contexts.japanese: これなら、あと一回ぐらいはなんとか投影が使える。
contexts.english: I should be able to manage one more Projection.

counterexamples.description: Comprehension failure distinguished from hearing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He hears but cannot understand her words.
counterexamples.explanation: Comprehension failure distinguished from hearing.

contexts.japanese: 聞こえないのではなく、遠坂は知らない言葉で喋っている。
contexts.english: It's not that I can't hear her, but Tohsaka's saying words I don't understand.

counterexamples.description: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sword he apparently projected is already with Rin while his hand is empty.
counterexamples.explanation: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.

contexts.japanese: アレはついさっき俺が投影した＜らしい＞もので、左手はとうに空っぽで、つまりもう遠坂に手渡したのか。
contexts.english: I just Projected that (I think), and my left hand is empty, which means I must've given it to her.

counterexamples.description: Memory loss follows intact-brain confidence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He feels chill and loss of memory with understanding not matching contents.
counterexamples.explanation: Memory loss follows intact-brain confidence.

contexts.japanese: 記憶がとんでいる。
contexts.english: My memory is going away.

counterexamples.description: Blood helps refocus at cost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Clenched hand sheds blood while eyes regain focus.
counterexamples.explanation: Blood helps refocus at cost.

contexts.japanese: ポタポタと血液がこぼれるかわりに、ようやく、目の焦点があってくれた。
contexts.english: Blood drips, but I finally manage to focus my eyes.

counterexamples.description: Light limbs coexist with failing head.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Limbs are oddly light compared with fragmented consciousness.
counterexamples.explanation: Light limbs coexist with failing head.

contexts.japanese: 断線だらけの頭に比べて、手足は異様に軽い。
contexts.english: My limbs feel light compared to my disconnected head.

counterexamples.description: Simple recollection unreachable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy cannot recall even a supposedly unforgettable provenance.
counterexamples.explanation: Simple recollection unreachable.

contexts.japanese: 簡単な、忘れられない事なのに、どうしても記憶の引き出しから出てこない。
contexts.english: It's something so easy and hard to forget, but I can't recall it no matter how hard I try.

counterexamples.description: Precious-pendant words are not wholly his.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says words not his spill out after keep-close-until-end insistence.
counterexamples.explanation: Precious-pendant words are not wholly his.

contexts.japanese: 自分のものではない言葉がこぼれる。
contexts.english: Words that aren't mine spill from my lips.

counterexamples.description: No pain does not mean healing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Living-creature functions continue eroding despite no arm pain.
counterexamples.explanation: No pain does not mean healing.

contexts.japanese: ただ、生物としての機能が、少しずつこそぎ落ちているだけだ。
contexts.english: My functions as a living creature are just slowly being eroded.

counterexamples.description: Stopping disrupts sense of purpose.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If he stops, he ceases understanding what he is doing.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopping disrupts sense of purpose.

contexts.japanese: 立ち止まっていると、自分が何をしているか判らなくなる。
contexts.english: If I stop, I won't know what I'm doing.

counterexamples.description: Recall instability is deliberate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy now cannot retrieve household life despite earlier evocative recollections.
counterexamples.explanation: Recall instability is deliberate.

contexts.japanese: この家で起きたコト、今まで過ごしてきたコトがこれっぽっちも思い出せない。
contexts.english: I can't remember anything that happened in this house, or anything I've experienced.

counterexamples.description: Legs collapsing internally.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Overuse breaks legs from within.
counterexamples.explanation: Legs collapsing internally.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの両脚は過度の酷使で、内部から崩壊しだしている。
contexts.english: Her legs are starting to collapse from within under the extreme strain.

counterexamples.description: Release precedes staged Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy loosens left-arm restraint while Rider attacks.
counterexamples.explanation: Release precedes staged Projection.

contexts.japanese: 左腕の拘束を緩め、
contexts.english: I loosen the binding on my left arm,

counterexamples.description: Meaning of seen world deteriorates.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Vision remains but understanding collapses painfully.
counterexamples.explanation: Meaning of seen world deteriorates.

contexts.japanese: 目に見えているモノの意味が、泣きたくなるぐらい、理解できなくなっていく。
contexts.english: I'm beginning to fail to understand anything I see, making me want to cry.

counterexamples.description: Urgent desire to restore shroud.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He urges restraint restored, unable to endure even a second.
counterexamples.explanation: Urgent desire to restore shroud.

contexts.japanese: 聖骸布を戻せ。
contexts.english: Put the shroud back on.

counterexamples.description: Fragmented hurry call stays broken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fear/pain disrupts request to Rider.
counterexamples.explanation: Fragmented hurry call stays broken.

contexts.japanese: 早く—早く、ま—なの—、ライ—ー。
contexts.english: Hurry—hurry, are—yet, Ri—?

counterexamples.description: Lost precious memory not identifiable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot remember even what vanished.
counterexamples.explanation: Lost precious memory not identifiable.

contexts.japanese: 何がなくなったのかも思い出せない。
contexts.english: I can't remember what I lost.

counterexamples.description: Bullet motion explicit analogy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body flies as fast as bullet.
counterexamples.explanation: Bullet motion explicit analogy.

contexts.japanese: 宙を跳ぶ体は弾丸のように速い。
contexts.english: and my body flies through the air like a bullet.

counterexamples.description: Backflow motif retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blood, senses and toxins all reverse.
counterexamples.explanation: Backflow motif retained.

contexts.japanese: 逆流する血液。逆流する感覚。逆流する毒素。
contexts.english: My blood flows backward. My senses flow backward. Poison flows backward.

counterexamples.description: Subjective tenfold time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: One second feels ten.
counterexamples.explanation: Subjective tenfold time.

contexts.japanese: 一秒が、十秒に感じられる。
contexts.english: One second feels like ten.

counterexamples.description: Irreplaceable loss remains broken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fragmented cognition registers something irreplaceable breaking.
counterexamples.explanation: Irreplaceable loss remains broken.

contexts.japanese: かくじ—、とりかえしのつか—ものが、コわれた。
contexts.english: I'm—that something irrepla—is broken.

counterexamples.description: Left eye destroyed in this variant.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He sees result through ruptured eye.
counterexamples.explanation: Left eye destroyed in this variant.

contexts.japanese: その成果を、破裂した左眼で見る。
contexts.english: I view the result with my destroyed left eye.

counterexamples.description: Scream retains blanks.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Largely blank scream leaves damaged expression.
counterexamples.explanation: Scream retains blanks.

counterexamples.description: Self-loss terror retained alongside body focus.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy screams to drive pain and fear of losing self away.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-loss terror retained alongside body focus.

contexts.japanese: 体内の痛み、自分が失われていく恐怖を追い返さんと絶叫する。
contexts.english: I scream to drive off the pain and terror of losing myself.

counterexamples.description: Sudden clarity after fading.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mind now terribly clear after near disappearance.
counterexamples.explanation: Sudden clarity after fading.

contexts.japanese: あれだけ消えそうだった意識が、今はひどくクリアだ。
contexts.english: My faded mind feels terribly clear.

counterexamples.description: Memory gouged and discarded.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He casts recollection beyond reach after killing with it.
counterexamples.explanation: Memory gouged and discarded.

contexts.japanese: 自分の記憶を抉り、手の届かないところに投げ捨てた。
contexts.english: I gouge out my memories and throw them into a place I can't reach.

counterexamples.description: Forgotten dagger circumstance retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot understand why dagger formerly held is in ground.
counterexamples.explanation: Forgotten dagger circumstance retained.

contexts.japanese: さっきまで握っていた筈の短剣が、どうして地面に刺さっていたのだろう。
contexts.english: I was just holding it. So why is it in the ground now?

counterexamples.description: One more Projection is a bounded self-estimate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Combined remaining mana seems usable, but one last Projection is limit before uncontrollable arm.
counterexamples.explanation: One more Projection is a bounded self-estimate.

contexts.japanese: 合わせればまだいけそうだが、投影はあと一度が限界だ。その後は何をしても、アーチャーの腕を抑えきれなくなる。
contexts.english: I think I can manage with that combined power, but I'm limited to one last Projection. I won't be able to control Archer's arm anymore, no matter what I do afterwards.

counterexamples.description: Distant voice stays unfamiliar.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not recognize the calling voice.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant voice stays unfamiliar.

contexts.japanese: 聞き覚えのない、
contexts.english: unfamiliar.

counterexamples.description: Precious voice impels tin body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Voice feels important and he moves his inert tin body.
counterexamples.explanation: Precious voice impels tin body.

contexts.japanese: 大切なもののような気がして、ブリキの体を前進させる。
contexts.english: It feels important to me. I walk on in my tin body.

counterexamples.description: Each step erodes thinking.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Progress carves away cognition with collapsing-building simile.
counterexamples.explanation: Each step erodes thinking.

contexts.japanese: 一歩進む度に脳は切り刻まれ、倒壊するビルのように、思考能力が削られていく。
contexts.english: With each step, something carves away my brain's ability to think, like a collapsing building.

counterexamples.description: Finite thought cycles retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thinking has a limited number of cycles left.
counterexamples.explanation: Finite thought cycles retained.

contexts.japanese: 既に、思考は回数制になっている。
contexts.english: My mind only has a limited number of cycles left.

counterexamples.description: Avoiding excess thought protects last weapon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Extra considerations must not degrade remaining Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Avoiding excess thought protects last weapon.

contexts.japanese: その最後の武器を、余分な“考察”で劣化させる訳にはいかない。
contexts.english: I can't allow any excess considerations to degrade my final weapon.

counterexamples.description: Alien smile causes forgotten words and Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her unlike-self smile makes him forget speech and projected object.
counterexamples.explanation: Alien smile causes forgotten words and Projection.

contexts.japanese: 言うべき言葉、投影すべき物を忘却させるほど、桜の笑みは“別人”すぎた。
contexts.english: Sakura's smile is so unlike herself that I forget what I was going to say or what I needed to Project.

counterexamples.description: Sensation immediately vanishes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses all body sensation instantly.
counterexamples.explanation: Sensation immediately vanishes.

contexts.japanese: 一瞬にして全身の感覚が消失する。
contexts.english: Instantly, I lose all sensation in my body.

counterexamples.description: Escape plan interrupts mid-utterance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Taking both women back breaks off.
counterexamples.explanation: Escape plan interrupts mid-utterance.

contexts.japanese: さっさと片付けて、二人を地上に連れ戻、
contexts.english: I'll clean this all up, and take them back—

counterexamples.description: Trust remains when name is lost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He recognizes familiar trustworthy woman without producing name.
counterexamples.explanation: Trust remains when name is lost.

contexts.japanese: よく知っている。なにやら物騒な格好をしているが、この女性は信頼できると、覚えている。
contexts.english: I know her well. She looks kinda scary, but I remember that this woman can be trusted.

counterexamples.description: Rider name remains broken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ri-R-R fails before he falls back on her speed.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider name remains broken.

contexts.japanese: 「頼む。なんとか二人を連れて外に出てくれ。洞窟、崩れ出してるだろ。ええっと、ラ—ラ、ラ、くそ、アンタの足なら、あんな落盤なんて問題じゃない」
contexts.english: "Thanks. Do what you can to get them out of here. The cave's gonna come down soon, right? Ri—R-R—damn it, anyway, I know you're fast enough to avoid any cave-ins."

counterexamples.description: Disconnecting consciousness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mind disconnects on hundred-meter approach.
counterexamples.explanation: Disconnecting consciousness retained.

contexts.japanese: 意識が断線する。
contexts.english: My consciousness disconnects.

counterexamples.description: Hundreds of inner blades retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blades grow from within body.
counterexamples.explanation: Hundreds of inner blades retained.

contexts.japanese: 体の中から、数百の刃が生えてくる。
contexts.english: Hundreds of blades are sprouting from my body.

counterexamples.description: End already set retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says end was determined long before.
counterexamples.explanation: End already set retained.

contexts.japanese: この終わりは、とうに決められていた事だ。
contexts.english: This ending was set a long time ago.

counterexamples.description: One day, hour or minute desired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He would take even one minute of extension.
counterexamples.explanation: One day, hour or minute desired.

contexts.japanese: たった一日。一時間でも一分でもいい。
contexts.english: Just one day. One hour. Even one minute.

counterexamples.description: Wants to live to limit despite appearances.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants remaining life however undignified.
counterexamples.explanation: Wants to live to limit despite appearances.

contexts.japanese: 生きていられるのなら、どんなにみっともなくても、限界までここにいたい。
contexts.english: If I'm going to live, I want to live as long as I can, appearances be damned.

counterexamples.description: Pleasure account remains character narration.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The scene equates life with pursuit of pleasure.
counterexamples.explanation: Pleasure account remains character narration.

contexts.japanese: “生きる”コトに一番重要な部分。生とは快楽の追求であり、それがない人間は獣と同じ。
contexts.english: The most important part of really being alive. Life is the pursuit of pleasure. Without it, humans are just beasts.

counterexamples.description: Arrival may cost identity and purpose.
counterexamples.sourceReading: By reaching target he expects to lose who he is and what to do.
counterexamples.explanation: Arrival may cost identity and purpose.

contexts.japanese: たどり着けたところで、自分が誰か、何をするかを、きっと無くしてしまっている。
contexts.english: By the time I get there, I won't even remember who I am or what I'm supposed to do.

counterexamples.description: For what and for whom disappear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses his reason and beneficiary for existence.
