counterexamples.explanation: For what and for whom disappear.

contexts.japanese: 何の為に誰の為に存在しているのか消失した。
contexts.english: I've lost what and whom I exist for.

counterexamples.description: Body dead explicitly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration states body is dead.
counterexamples.explanation: Body dead explicitly retained.

contexts.japanese: 肉体は死んだ。
contexts.english: My body is dead.

counterexamples.description: Soul remains explicitly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul remains here despite body death.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul remains explicitly retained.

contexts.japanese: だが、ここに、魂が残されている。
contexts.english: But my soul is still here.

counterexamples.description: Shirou died statement retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says Shirou Emiya died.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou died statement retained.

contexts.japanese: そうして衛宮士郎は死んだ。
contexts.english: That's how Shirou Emiya died.

counterexamples.description: Only enough oxygen to move.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Breath brings just enough oxygen for movement.
counterexamples.explanation: Only enough oxygen to move.

contexts.japanese: 呼吸をして、体に、動けるだけの酸素を入れる。
contexts.english: I breathe, taking in just enough oxygen to move.

counterexamples.description: Throat has just one movement.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He can move throat only once.
counterexamples.explanation: Throat has just one movement.

contexts.japanese: 喉は一度しか動かない。
contexts.english: I can only move my throat once.

counterexamples.description: Left arm unsealed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He releases left arm.
counterexamples.explanation: Left arm unsealed.

contexts.japanese: 左腕を解放する。
contexts.english: I unseal my left arm.

counterexamples.description: Consciousness nearly gone.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Awareness is close to disappearing.
counterexamples.explanation: Consciousness nearly gone.

contexts.japanese: 意識が消えかけてきた。
contexts.english: My consciousness is almost gone.

counterexamples.description: Absolute end prospective in unfinished connector.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls this absolute end before unfinished I.
counterexamples.explanation: Absolute end prospective in unfinished connector.

contexts.japanese: それは絶対の終わりだ。
contexts.english: This is the absolute end.

counterexamples.description: Oxygen doubt remains uncertain and broken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether present self needs oxygen and begins a failing movement forecast.
counterexamples.explanation: Oxygen doubt remains uncertain and broken.

contexts.japanese: だが、もしかすると、酸素なんてなくても今の自分は動けるし、酸素をいっぱいとったところで、もうじき動けなくな
contexts.english: But right now, maybe I can move without any oxygen, and even if I breathed in a lot, it won't be long before I—

counterexamples.description: Speaker blank retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Name before told me is absent.
counterexamples.explanation: Speaker blank retained.

contexts.japanese: —は言った。
contexts.english: —told me.

counterexamples.description: Opponent name first absent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blank figure stands before Grail in crimson light.
counterexamples.explanation: Opponent name first absent.

contexts.japanese: 赤黒い炎に照らされて、—が立っている。
contexts.english: stands —, lit by dark crimson flames.

counterexamples.description: Forgotten breathing restarted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He resumes breath forgotten during exchange.
counterexamples.explanation: Forgotten breathing restarted.

contexts.japanese: 忘れていた呼吸を再開する。
contexts.english: I restart my forgotten breathing.

counterexamples.description: Organ-destroying power remains counterfactual.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even second punch had power to destroy organs.
counterexamples.explanation: Organ-destroying power remains counterfactual.

contexts.japanese: いや、それを言うなら腹を叩いた二撃目ですら、内臓を破壊する威力があった。
contexts.english: No, if we're going with that, even the second blow to my stomach would have destroyed my organs.

counterexamples.description: Striking blade body costs attacker.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Bloody hand is price of attacking bundle of blades barehanded.
counterexamples.explanation: Striking blade body costs attacker.

contexts.japanese: 刃の塊を素手で砕こうとした代償だった。
contexts.english: what he gets for hitting a bundle of blades.

counterexamples.description: Hourglass vessel breaks before sand empties.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At current rate body-clock vessel shatters before life-time runs out.
counterexamples.explanation: Hourglass vessel breaks before sand empties.

contexts.japanese: このままでいけば、砂時計が空っぽになる前に砂時計ごと破壊される。
contexts.english: At this rate, my hourglass will shatter before it even runs out.

counterexamples.description: Opening remains shortened variant.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Consciousness disconnects without09's extra hundred-meter eternity line.
counterexamples.explanation: Opening remains shortened variant.

contexts.japanese: 意識が断線する。
contexts.english: My mind disconnects.

counterexamples.description: Hundreds of blades arise within.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blades grow from body interior.
counterexamples.explanation: Hundreds of blades arise within.

contexts.japanese: 体の中から、数百の刃が生えてくる。
contexts.english: Hundreds of blades are sprouting from my body.

counterexamples.description: Predetermined ending retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: End had already been set.
counterexamples.explanation: Predetermined ending retained.

contexts.japanese: この終わりは、とうに決められていた事だ。
contexts.english: This ending was set a long time ago.

counterexamples.description: Even minute desired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He longs for one day, hour or minute.
counterexamples.explanation: Even minute desired.

contexts.japanese: たった一日。一時間でも一分でもいい。
contexts.english: Just one day. One hour. Even one minute.

counterexamples.description: Desire to live despite shame retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants live to limit regardless of appearance.
counterexamples.explanation: Desire to live despite shame retained.

contexts.japanese: 生きていられるのなら、どんなにみっともなくても、限界までここにいたい。
contexts.english: If I'm going to live, I want to live as long as I can, appearances be damned.

counterexamples.description: Concrete finger biting present.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He bites fingers trying to preserve self.
counterexamples.explanation: Concrete finger biting present.

contexts.japanese: 自分が自分のままでいる事に、指を食うほど執着している。
contexts.english: I bite my fingers to remind myself that I'm still me.

counterexamples.description: Each step erases him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Self disappears with forward steps.
counterexamples.explanation: Each step erases him.

contexts.japanese: 一歩進む度に俺は消える。
contexts.english: With each step forward, I disappear.

counterexamples.description: Purpose and beneficiary lost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses for what and whom he exists.
counterexamples.explanation: Purpose and beneficiary lost.

contexts.japanese: 何の為に誰の為に存在しているのか消失した。
contexts.english: I've lost what and whom I exist for.

counterexamples.description: Body death remains separate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body is dead.
counterexamples.explanation: Body death remains separate.

contexts.japanese: 肉体は死んだ。
contexts.english: My body is dead.

counterexamples.description: Soul remains despite body death.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul stays here.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul remains despite body death.

contexts.japanese: だが、ここに、魂が残されている。
contexts.english: But my soul is still here.

counterexamples.description: Named death statement retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says Shirou Emiya died.
counterexamples.explanation: Named death statement retained.

contexts.japanese: そうして衛宮士郎は死んだ。
contexts.english: That's how Shirou Emiya died.

counterexamples.description: Use bars return.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Using last Projection means no going back.
counterexamples.explanation: Use bars return.

contexts.japanese: 使えば、絶対に戻れない。
contexts.english: If I use this, there's no going back.

counterexamples.description: Speaker name forgotten.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He hears voice without remembering name.
counterexamples.explanation: Speaker name forgotten.

contexts.japanese: もう名前も思い出せない、誰かの声。
contexts.english: Someone's voice. I can't remember her name.

counterexamples.description: Imperfect body and Rin trial-and-error preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Only her body can be used; imperfect result expected fixable with Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Imperfect body and Rin trial-and-error preserved.

contexts.japanese: 使えるのはわたしの体しかないから、完全に再現はできないの。けどだいじょうぶ。リンといっしょに試行錯誤すれば、すぐに元通りにしてもらえるわ。
contexts.english: We only have my body to use, so I can't completely recreate it. It'll be okay, though. If you do some trial and error with Rin, I'm sure you can go back to normal.

counterexamples.description: No mana remains in body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not even fragment of power left.
counterexamples.explanation: No mana remains in body.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

counterexamples.description: Cold pain restores failing awareness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pain wakes sinking consciousness.
counterexamples.explanation: Cold pain restores failing awareness.

contexts.japanese: それは沈みかけた意識を覚ます—
contexts.english: It awakens my sinking mind.

counterexamples.description: Losing focus threatens disconnection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If attention lapses mind shuts off.
counterexamples.explanation: Losing focus threatens disconnection.

contexts.japanese: 気を抜けば意識が切れる。
contexts.english: If I lose focus, my mind will shut off.

counterexamples.description: Right-hand pendant retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He grips pendant tightly with right hand.
counterexamples.explanation: Right-hand pendant retained.

contexts.japanese: 右手に持ったペンダントを強く握る。
contexts.english: I grip the pendant tightly in my right hand.

counterexamples.description: Each swing severs arm muscle.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Weapon penalty physically cuts muscles each use.
counterexamples.explanation: Each swing severs arm muscle.

contexts.japanese: 一撃振るう度に腕の筋肉を切断していく、宝石剣からの代償に。
contexts.english: Each time she swings the blade, her arm muscles are severed. It's the price for using the Jeweled Sword.

counterexamples.description: Distant-thunder memory inaccessible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders but cannot retrieve hearing such thunder.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant-thunder memory inaccessible.

contexts.japanese: ぼんやりと頭に浮かんだが、いつ、遠雷なんてものを聞いたのか、思い出す事ができなかった。
contexts.english: I wonder about it absently, but I can't remember a time I ever heard distant thunder.

counterexamples.description: One final Projection estimated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Combined reserves seem usable once, then uncontrollable arm.
counterexamples.explanation: One final Projection estimated.

contexts.japanese: 合わせればまだいけそうだが、投影はあと一度が限界だ。その後は何をしても、アーチャーの腕を抑えきれなくなる。
contexts.english: I think I can manage with that combined power, but I'm limited to one last Projection. I won't be able to control Archer's arm anymore, no matter what I do afterwards.

counterexamples.description: Bullet-proof impression remains boast.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He bets bullet would bounce with metallic joints.
counterexamples.explanation: Bullet-proof impression remains boast.

contexts.japanese: これなら、鉄砲をうけても跳ね返しそうだ。
contexts.english: I bet bullets would bounce off me now.

counterexamples.description: Bleeding deliberately ignored.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He pretends not see blood.
counterexamples.explanation: Bleeding deliberately ignored.

contexts.japanese: 見ないフリをした。
contexts.english: I pretend not to see it.

counterexamples.description: Cough product unnamed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Something exits mouth.
counterexamples.explanation: Cough product unnamed.

contexts.japanese: 口から何か出た。
contexts.english: Something comes out of my mouth.

counterexamples.description: Clothes split from inside.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wound opens through clothes internally.
counterexamples.explanation: Clothes split from inside.

contexts.japanese: 服が内側から破れて、大きな傷口が見えていた。
contexts.english: My clothes are torn from the inside, and I can see gaping wounds.

counterexamples.description: Penetration expressly negated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow attacks slide aside with sparks, do not pierce.
counterexamples.explanation: Penetration expressly negated.

contexts.japanese: 影は突き刺さらず、火花をこぼしてズレていく。
contexts.english: They get deflected and fail to pierce me, throwing up a shower of sparks.

counterexamples.description: All remaining mana spent on one replication.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou's remaining energy entirely poured into copy.
counterexamples.explanation: All remaining mana spent on one replication.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎に残った魔力を、全てその複製に注ぎ込む。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya devotes all of his remaining magical energy into its replication.

counterexamples.description: Gathered worms no longer sustain humanoid form.
counterexamples.sourceReading: All underground worms formed one flesh mass but no human outline remains.
counterexamples.explanation: Gathered worms no longer sustain humanoid form.

contexts.japanese: その全てを集め、一つの肉にしたところで、もはや人のカタチさえ保てない。
contexts.english: He gathered them all to form a single lump of flesh, but he cannot maintain a humanoid body anymore.

counterexamples.description: Twice-crushed damage irreversible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hastily built worms do not heal two destructions.
counterexamples.explanation: Twice-crushed damage irreversible.

contexts.japanese: 腐敗する魂を急造の蟲に詰め込んだところで、二度潰された傷は癒えるものではない。
contexts.english: Although he has fit his soul into a hastily-assembled swarm of insects, he will never recover from being crushed twice.

counterexamples.description: Internal destruction bypasses altered exterior.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Palm blow targets interior rather than surface.
counterexamples.explanation: Internal destruction bypasses altered exterior.

contexts.japanese: 外側ではなく内側の破壊を旨とした一撃は、容赦なく衝撃を通してくる。
contexts.english: His attack, aimed at doing internal rather than external damage, ruthlessly sends shockwaves through me.

counterexamples.description: Whitening caused by repair invasion rather than enemy damage.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pain comes from arm's repairing/rewriting body, not direct damage.
counterexamples.explanation: Whitening caused by repair invasion rather than enemy damage.

contexts.japanese: それは敵によるダメージではなく、傷ついた体を直し、書き換えようとする、左腕からの痛みだった。
contexts.english: It isn't the damage from his attacks, but from the pain of my left arm repairing and overwriting my injured body.

counterexamples.description: Head strike can end combat in one blow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Untransformed face/head only vulnerable surface.
counterexamples.explanation: Head strike can end combat in one blow.

contexts.japanese: 頭に直撃されては一撃で終わる。
contexts.english: This could end with a single blow to my head.

counterexamples.description: Brain erosion is cost of blade survival.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blades keep body alive in exchange for brain loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Brain erosion is cost of blade survival.

contexts.japanese: それと引き換えに脳髄が削られていく。
contexts.english: In exchange, my brain is shaved away.

counterexamples.description: Kirei endures reciprocal injury with visible pain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His hand bones break and face twists, continues striking.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei endures reciprocal injury with visible pain.

contexts.japanese: それに耐え、顔を苦悶に歪めながら敵は俺を打ってくる。
contexts.english: He endures it, his face twisted in pain, and continues striking me.

counterexamples.description: One-second mental burnout retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pain burns him out in another second, ending thought.
counterexamples.explanation: One-second mental burnout retained.

contexts.japanese: あと一秒で痛みに耐え切れず焼き切れ、何も考えられなくなる。
contexts.english: In one more second, I'll give into the pain and burn out, and I won't be able to think anymore.

counterexamples.description: Sleep contradiction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says not slept once; boy claims properly slept.
counterexamples.explanation: Sleep contradiction retained.

contexts.japanese: 「馬鹿言わないで。士郎、一睡もしてないでしょ。そんな体でいられちゃわたしたちが困るってわからない？」
contexts.english: "Don't be stupid, Shirou. You haven't been sleeping at all. It's going to be a problem for all of us if you stay in that condition."

contexts.japanese: 「それこそバカ言うなよ。昨日はちゃんと眠ったぞ、俺」
contexts.english: "You're the one who sounds stupid. I got a full night's sleep yesterday."

counterexamples.description: Nearly5km continuous sprint and subjective wellness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy feels astonishingly good after near5km.
counterexamples.explanation: Nearly5km continuous sprint and subjective wellness.

contexts.japanese: 自分でもびっくりするぐらい、体の調子がいい。
contexts.english: Physically, I feel surprisingly good.

contexts.japanese: 最短距離とは言え、家から教会まで、実に五キロ近い道のりを全力疾走したんだから。
contexts.english: I ran nearly five kilometers from home to the church at a full sprint, even if it was the shortest route.

counterexamples.description: Relief followed renewed burning transformation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Accepted current pain eases then skin burns from mud.
counterexamples.explanation: Relief followed renewed burning transformation.

contexts.japanese: 痛みは炎になって、少女の肌を焦がしていく。
contexts.english: The pain becomes fire, and it burns her skin.

counterexamples.description: Lost left arm's destruction callback survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: A touch melted his original left arm helplessly.
counterexamples.explanation: Lost left arm's destruction callback survives.

contexts.japanese: ……為す術もなく、触れられただけで溶けていった左腕。
contexts.english: All it took was a touch to melt my left arm.

counterexamples.description: Mind-before-body destruction conditional survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If the blank mind is exposed now, mind disappears before body.
counterexamples.explanation: Mind-before-body destruction conditional survives.

contexts.japanese: それがこんな、真っ白のまま浴びたのならからだの前に心が消える。
contexts.english: If it covers me while my mind is still blank, my mind will disappear before my body.

counterexamples.description: Escape fails for lack of ground rather than lack of will.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After pain motivates bodily escape, he cannot jump because no ground to kick.
counterexamples.explanation: Escape fails for lack of ground rather than lack of will.

contexts.japanese: そもそも蹴るべき地面がない。
contexts.english: There's no ground to push off of.

contexts.japanese: それが思いのほか苦しく、恐ろしかったから、外に出たいと体が動いた。
contexts.english: It's more suffocating and scary than I expected, so I move my body to try and get out.

counterexamples.description: Standing risks consciousness, not a claim Rider forbids all motion forever.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Do not move; standing in present condition loses consciousness.
counterexamples.explanation: Standing risks consciousness, not a claim Rider forbids all motion forever.

contexts.japanese: 「動かないように。その体で立ち上がれば意識が途絶えます」
contexts.english: "Try not to move. If you stand up in that condition, you will lose consciousness."

counterexamples.description: Will sustaining motion fails and limbs collapse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Driving will ends, limbs fall like cut-string puppet.
counterexamples.explanation: Will sustaining motion fails and limbs collapse.

contexts.japanese: 体を動かしていた気力が途絶える。
contexts.english: I run out of the will to move my body.

contexts.japanese: 手足は、糸の切れた人形のように地面に落ちる。
contexts.english: My arms and legs go limp, like a puppet with its strings cut.

counterexamples.description: Final inability to remain conscious survives in intact entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Consciousness cannot continue.
counterexamples.explanation: Final inability to remain conscious survives in intact entry.

contexts.japanese: ……意識が続かない。
contexts.english: ...I can't stay conscious.

counterexamples.description: Apparent wellness is performance, relapse possible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Acting lively but could fall like yesterday unpredictably.
counterexamples.explanation: Apparent wellness is performance, relapse possible.

contexts.japanese: 桜は元気に振舞っているが、いつ昨日のように倒れるか判らない。
contexts.english: She's acting like she's in good health, but she could collapse at any time, like she did yesterday.

counterexamples.description: Worm response to dark feeling retains as-if relation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Crawl nerves as though answering dark desire.
counterexamples.explanation: Worm response to dark feeling retains as-if relation.

contexts.japanese: 体内の虫が、彼女の暗い情念に応えるように神経を這う。
contexts.english: The worms inside her wriggle up and down her nerves, as if responding to her dark desires.

counterexamples.description: First-person disgust separated from surrounding narration.
counterexamples.sourceReading: My body ugly/wicked to be excited; active source short line.
counterexamples.explanation: First-person disgust separated from surrounding narration.

contexts.japanese: わたしの体は醜く、こんな事で興奮するほど邪だ。
contexts.english: My body is so disgusting, so wicked, to be aroused by something like this.

counterexamples.description: Blood-dissolved worms become sweet poison warming body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Internal mixture and heat remain concrete descriptions.
counterexamples.explanation: Blood-dissolved worms become sweet poison warming body.

contexts.japanese: ……血液に溶けた虫は甘い毒となって、彼女の体を熱していく。
contexts.english: ...The worms that dissolved in her blood become a sweet poison, heating her body.

counterexamples.description: Worm transformation expressed as feeling.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She feels has become worm under ominous illusion.
counterexamples.explanation: Worm transformation expressed as feeling.

contexts.japanese: —自分が、虫になった気がする。
contexts.english: She feels like she's become a worm.

counterexamples.description: Vague memories and lost limb sensation remain despite memory-tense error.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Memories blur daily, no hands/feet sensation, fragmented time.
counterexamples.explanation: Vague memories and lost limb sensation remain despite memory-tense error.

contexts.japanese: 今はちゃんとしてるけど、気を抜くとね、自分が何をしていたか分からなくなるの。……日に日に記憶が曖昧になって、手足の感覚もない。時間の感覚だってもうバラバラで、一日が長く続いてくれないんだ。
contexts.english: I'm still myself now, but if I lose focus, I don't know what I'll do... My memories are getting more vague each day, and I can't feel my arms and legs anymore. My sense of time is all over the place, and I can't even keep track of a day anymore.

counterexamples.description: Unmotivated idle stretch and weary waking preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Arm stretches without purpose, blankly watches ceiling.
counterexamples.explanation: Unmotivated idle stretch and weary waking preserved.

contexts.japanese: 意味もなく片手を伸ばして、ぼんやりと天井を眺めて、ぱたん、と伸ばした腕が布団に落ちた。
contexts.english: I stick my arm up in the air for no real reason, stare at the ceiling, then let it fall on the futon.

counterexamples.description: Accumulated fatigue hypothesis stays tentative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wonders whether fatigue built up.
counterexamples.explanation: Accumulated fatigue hypothesis stays tentative.

contexts.japanese: 疲労が溜まっているんだろうか。
contexts.english: Maybe the fatigue has been building up.

counterexamples.description: Self-demand follows Sakura worse condition and effort.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She striving alone so his lesser fatigue no excuse to rest.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-demand follows Sakura worse condition and effort.

contexts.japanese: その桜が一人で頑張ってるんだから、この程度のだるさで休んでられるかって言うのだ。
contexts.english: She's doing her best, so I can't let a little grogginess keep me down.

counterexamples.description: Embarrassed dizziness distinct from physical sluggishness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not body fatigue, doorway reminds last night.
counterexamples.explanation: Embarrassed dizziness distinct from physical sluggishness.

contexts.japanese: 体のだるさからではない。
contexts.english: It isn't from my body's slowness.

contexts.japanese: なんというか、入り口に目を向けた途端、昨夜のコトをよけいに思い出してしまったからだ。
contexts.english: It's like...as soon as I look at my bedroom door, I remember what happened last night all too vividly.

counterexamples.description: Uneven terrain drains stamina gradually.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Less severe than mountain but unpaved ground taxes body bit by bit.
counterexamples.explanation: Uneven terrain drains stamina gradually.

contexts.japanese: 山道ほどではないにしろ、舗装されていない地面は少しずつ体力を奪っていく。
contexts.english: It isn't as bad as walking in the mountains, but the uneven terrain saps my stamina, bit by bit.

counterexamples.description: Physical stamina and unnoticed mental fatigue remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Daily training makes all-day path possible, but mental fatigue silently costs strength.
counterexamples.explanation: Physical stamina and unnoticed mental fatigue remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 日頃鍛えている分、この程度の獣道なら一日歩いたところで問題はないが、精神面の疲れは気付かないうちに体力を奪うものだ。
contexts.english: Thanks to my daily training, I don't have a problem with walking in the wilderness all day, but it does build up mental fatigue that isn't easy to notice.

counterexamples.description: Mental disturbance can cause small mistakes before physical limit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body limit distant; disordered mind may produce minor errors.
counterexamples.explanation: Mental disturbance can cause small mistakes before physical limit.

contexts.japanese: 体力的な限界はまだ先だろうが、乱れた精神では些細なミスも起こすだろう。
contexts.english: My physical limits are still a ways off, but the mental stress could cause me to start making small mistakes.

counterexamples.description: Distant sound is only explosion-like.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Trees shake and noise resembles blast before storm comparison.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant sound is only explosion-like.

contexts.japanese: 遠くからは爆発めいた音が響いてくる。
contexts.english: A noise that resembles an explosion echoes from afar.

counterexamples.description: Rin infers a single opponent without naming them.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Given their presence, only one possible foe for Berserker, identity withheld.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin infers a single opponent without naming them.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。わたしたちがここにいる以上、バーサーカーが戦う相手は一人しかいない。……どうする？　わたしは行くけど、衛宮くんは残る？」
contexts.english: "Yeah. Since we're here, there's only one person he could possibly be fighting against... So what now? I'm going ahead. Are you staying?"

counterexamples.description: Opponent identification remains Shirou's deduction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Assumes Berserker against Zouken/Assassin.
counterexamples.explanation: Opponent identification remains Shirou's deduction.

contexts.japanese: 相手は臓硯とアサシン以外にない。
contexts.english: He must be up against Zouken and Assassin.

counterexamples.description: Saber callback destabilizes confidence in raw superiority.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber also shouldn't have lost.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber callback destabilizes confidence in raw superiority.

contexts.japanese: だが—敗ける筈がなかったのは、セイバーも同じではなかったか。
contexts.english: But...wasn't that true for Saber, too?

counterexamples.description: Initial darkness isn't absence of light.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Retina paralyzed by black light like sun glare.
counterexamples.explanation: Initial darkness isn't absence of light.

contexts.japanese: 光が途絶えた事による闇ではない。
contexts.english: It isn't the darkness that comes from an absence of light.

contexts.japanese: 強烈な閃光、太陽を直視したように、網膜が黒い光に麻痺している。
contexts.english: Instead, a dark light is seared into my retinas, like I've just looked directly into the sun.

counterexamples.description: Tree collisions prove tangible forest initially.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Groping blind, random movement hits trunks.
counterexamples.explanation: Tree collisions prove tangible forest initially.

contexts.japanese: デタラメに進むたびに、木の幹が体に当たる。
contexts.english: I bump into tree trunks.

counterexamples.description: Painful contact reassures against nothingness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Injury preferable to no response/existence.
counterexamples.explanation: Painful contact reassures against nothingness.

contexts.japanese: 何かにぶつかって怪我をする方が、何も“無い”よりは安心できる。
contexts.english: Getting injured from bumping into things is more comforting than nothing at all.

counterexamples.description: Temporary-blindness explanation remains self-reassurance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tells himself sudden light caused short vision loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Temporary-blindness explanation remains self-reassurance.

contexts.japanese: 大丈夫、突然の光で一時的に視力が飛んだだけだ。
contexts.english: I'll be all right. It's just temporary blindness from seeing a sudden bright light.

counterexamples.description: Repetition escalates false certainty of recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Waits through lengthening pauses and insists vision absolutely returns.
counterexamples.explanation: Repetition escalates false certainty of recovery.

contexts.japanese: 視力は戻る。それだけは絶対と言い切れる。
contexts.english: My eyesight will return. I can say that for sure.

counterexamples.description: Missing collisions become explicit source of worry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Storm and impacts stop; he questions meaning.
counterexamples.explanation: Missing collisions become explicit source of worry.

contexts.japanese: あれだけ密集していた木にぶつからなくなった事に、なにか意味があるのだろうか……？
contexts.english: I wonder what it means that I've stopped bumping into all those trees.

counterexamples.description: Restored eyes and absent world are both stated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Numbness gone and vision normal, forest touch vanished; he defers implications.
counterexamples.explanation: Restored eyes and absent world are both stated.

contexts.japanese: 眼球の痺れはとっくにとれていて、視力が元通りになっている事も、後で考えるとしよう。
contexts.english: I can wonder later why it's dark even though my eyes are working again and my vision is back to normal.

contexts.japanese: 森の手触りがなくなった事は、まあ、後で考えればいい。
contexts.english: I can ponder later why I'm not touching the forest anymore.

counterexamples.description: He walks through sensationless nothingness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Continues through void without tactile contact.
counterexamples.explanation: He walks through sensationless nothingness.

contexts.japanese: 感触のない無を歩いていく。
contexts.english: Still feeling nothing, I walk through the darkness.

counterexamples.description: Exitless shadow world remains framed as bad joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He imagines trapped there and brittlely dismisses it.
counterexamples.explanation: Exitless shadow world remains framed as bad joke.

contexts.japanese: 出口のない影の世界に囚われたような、質の悪い冗談とかを。
contexts.english: A bad joke like that, maybe.

counterexamples.description: Repeated little longer survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Brittle reassurance repeats while no sensation.
counterexamples.explanation: Repeated little longer survives.

contexts.japanese: だがあと少しだ。
contexts.english: But it's just a little longer.

counterexamples.description: Three Servants are counted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Berserker, Assassin, unknown black-armored swordsman clash.
counterexamples.explanation: Three Servants are counted.

contexts.japanese: 刃を交わらせるサーヴァントは三体。
contexts.english: Three Servants are clashing weapons.

counterexamples.description: First giant blow misses and destroys ground.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mountain-splitting strike cuts empty air and blasts earth.
counterexamples.explanation: First giant blow misses and destroys ground.

contexts.japanese: 岩山をも砕かんとする一撃は虚しく宙を切り、地面を吹き飛ばす。
contexts.english: He cleaves through the air with enough force to split a mountain, making the earth explode.

counterexamples.description: Illya fears nonreturn after capture by opponent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Orders escape, no more fighting; being got means cannot come back.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya fears nonreturn after capture by opponent.

contexts.japanese: 「だめ、逃げるのバーサーカー……！　そいつにやられたら戻ってこれなくなる……！　もう戦わなくていいから、早く……！」
contexts.english: "No, Berserker! Run! If that gets you, you won't be able to come back to me! You don't have to fight anymore!"

counterexamples.description: Assassin's earlier defeat remains inferred.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Appears to have lost to Berserker.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin's earlier defeat remains inferred.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯の前にはバーサーカーに敗れたであろうアサシン。
contexts.english: In front of Zouken is Assassin, who seems to have lost to Berserker.

counterexamples.description: Shadow tendrils restrain limbs.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Black vines extend from mire and bind giant's extremities.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow tendrils restrain limbs.

contexts.japanese: そればかりではなく、沼からは黒い蔦が伸び、巨人の手足さえ拘束していた。
contexts.english: On top of that, black vines from the swamp trap his arms and legs.

counterexamples.description: Berserker still fights evenly while being swallowed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Raw contest remains equal despite restraint.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker still fights evenly while being swallowed.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”に呑まれようとしているのに、黒い剣士と互角に戦っているのだ。
contexts.english: He's fighting the black swordsman evenly, even as the Shadow tries to swallow him.

counterexamples.description: Deteriorating mobility tips otherwise equal strength.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even if equal or greater Servant ability, freedom stripped over time.
counterexamples.explanation: Deteriorating mobility tips otherwise equal strength.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントとしての実力は互角かそれ以上だとしても、バーサーカーは刻一刻と自由を奪われていく。
contexts.english: Even if he's at least as strong as his opponent, Berserker's freedom of movement is stripped away as the fight drags on.

counterexamples.description: Capture order follows Berserker consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken withdraws, tells Assassin bring Illya after Shadow consumes Berserker.
counterexamples.explanation: Capture order follows Berserker consumption.

contexts.japanese: 後は任せたぞアサシン。これ以上ここにおっては巻き添えをくらいかねん。バーサーカーが呑まれ次第、アインツベルンの娘を捕らえ戻ってくるがよい」
contexts.english: Take care of the rest, Assassin. It is too risky for me to remain here any longer. Once it consumes Berserker, capture and bring back the Einzbern girl."

counterexamples.description: Assassin must keep Illya from indiscriminate consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow consumes visible things especially magical masses; captive must not be swallowed.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin must keep Illya from indiscriminate consumption.

contexts.japanese: それが魔力の塊ならば尚の事だ。アインツベルンの娘、むざむざ呑まれる事のないようにな」
contexts.english: Especially any dense sources of magical energy. Be careful not to let the Einzbern girl be taken, too."

counterexamples.description: The text first insists movement should be impossible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fully bound/corroded giant can't take a step before reveal.
counterexamples.explanation: The text first insists movement should be impossible.

contexts.japanese: 黒い影に体を侵食されたバーサーカーは一歩たりとて動けない。
contexts.english: His body was getting eaten by the Shadow, meaning Berserker couldn't take a single step.

counterexamples.description: Self-mutilation required to tear free survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He peels own body with attached Shadow, nearly exposing interior.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-mutilation required to tear free survives.

contexts.japanese: —絡みついた部分ごと、中身が覗こうという勢いで、自らの身体を剥いだのだ。
contexts.english: —He literally tore his body open wherever the Shadow had grabbed him, exposing his innards.

counterexamples.description: Final-blow judgment stays probabilistic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Probably last strike, expected decisive.
counterexamples.explanation: Final-blow judgment stays probabilistic.

contexts.japanese: おそらくは最後の一撃。
contexts.english: This will likely be the last blow.

counterexamples.description: Swordsman answers with strongest attack.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Counter meets desperate blow at maximum.
counterexamples.explanation: Swordsman answers with strongest attack.

contexts.japanese: 剣士は、最強の一撃を以って迎撃する。
contexts.english: ...with their greatest attack.

counterexamples.description: Illya runs heedless toward Berserker and spreading Shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: As if unable see danger, single-minded advance.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya runs heedless toward Berserker and spreading Shadow.

contexts.japanese: 巨人の足元に広がる影が見えないかのように、一心にバーサーカーへと走り出す。
contexts.english: She starts running desperately towards Berserker, as if she can't see the spreading Shadow at his feet.

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes no chance against either threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Intervention seems futile against Shadow or swordsman.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes no chance against either threat.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”にも黒い剣士にも勝てる見込みなんてない。
contexts.english: I don't have a chance of winning against the Shadow or the swordsman.

counterexamples.description: Illya raises castle defenses before threat arrives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Senses great approaching enemy, maximizes barriers and wakes giant.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya raises castle defenses before threat arrives.

contexts.japanese: それが強大なものと感じ取れるが故に、少女は城の防壁を最大にし、現れるであろう“敵”に備えて巨人を起こした。
contexts.english: When she sensed how great the threat was, she raised the castle's defenses to maximum and woke up the giant in preparation for its arrival.

counterexamples.description: Her confidence is self-reassurance over dread.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tells herself defenses enough to cap anxiety.
counterexamples.explanation: Her confidence is self-reassurance over dread.

contexts.japanese: そう自分に言い聞かせて、少女は堪えきれない不安に蓋をした。
contexts.english: That's what she told herself as she tried to fight down the sense of inevitable dread.

counterexamples.description: Speechless Berserker independently perceives unwinnable danger.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even deprived reason/words communicates flight.
counterexamples.explanation: Speechless Berserker independently perceives unwinnable danger.

contexts.japanese: 理性を奪われ、口を閉ざした筈の狂戦士でさえ、目前に迫った“何か”には勝てないと悟ったのだ。
contexts.english: Robbed of his sanity and speech, even the mad warrior sensed that he couldn't win against whatever was coming for them.

counterexamples.description: Fear concerns losing Berserker rather than defeat alone.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Flight motivated by Servant ceasing hers.
counterexamples.explanation: Fear concerns losing Berserker rather than defeat alone.

contexts.japanese: 少女は敗北ではなく、自らのサーヴァントを失う事を恐れて城から逃げだした。
contexts.english: The girl ran because she was afraid of losing her Servant, not losing the fight.

counterexamples.description: Intercepting pair aren't the sensed castle threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya and giant fear something else.
counterexamples.explanation: Intercepting pair aren't the sensed castle threat.

contexts.japanese: 少女と巨人が脅威を感じたモノは、間違っても目前の敵ではないのだから。
contexts.english: The threat that she and the giant felt is most certainly not the person in front of them.

counterexamples.description: Assassin independently halts from fatal assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Against Master's intent, knows attack means bisected.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin independently halts from fatal assessment.

contexts.japanese: そう確信したがため、暗殺者は動かずにいた。
contexts.english: So he stays still, knowing full well what awaits him.

counterexamples.description: Berserker attacks without waiting for Master's command.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Independent sortie despite her recall.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker attacks without waiting for Master's command.

contexts.japanese: 黒い巨人は、少女の命を待たずして出陣した。
contexts.english: The dark giant moves out without waiting for his Master's command.

contexts.japanese: 「だめ……！　戻ってバーサーカー……！」
contexts.english: "No...! Come back, Berserker!"

contexts.japanese: 少女の声は届かず。
contexts.english: Her voice doesn't reach him.

counterexamples.description: Archer watches Assassin and approaching second threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Warning is about Shadow behind pursuer.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer watches Assassin and approaching second threat.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーの視線はアサシンと、その奥からやってくる何かに向けられている。
contexts.english: Archer's looking at Assassin and something else approaching from behind him.

counterexamples.description: Archer explains himself as improper Heroic Spirit aligned with mud.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Relative irregularity allows action, not general immunity.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer explains himself as improper Heroic Spirit aligned with mud.

contexts.japanese: 「知れた事。私は他の連中のようにまっとうな英雄ではない。正純ではない英霊ならばあの泥と同位。
contexts.english: "It's simple. I'm not a proper hero like the others. I'm on the same level as that mud.

counterexamples.description: Shadow emergence breaks false relief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Appears behind Rin as if born from tree shade.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow emergence breaks false relief.

contexts.japanese: 木々の影から生まれるように、アレが、浮かび上がっていた。
contexts.english: It boils up, as if it was born in the shade of the trees.

counterexamples.description: Shirou anticipates Rin's impalement without reaching her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: About to witness tentacle pierce Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou anticipates Rin's impalement without reaching her.

contexts.japanese: 俺は、遠坂の体が黒い触手に貫かれるのを目の当たりにしようとし、
contexts.english: I can only watch as the tentacles lance forth to impale Tohsaka...

counterexamples.description: Servant summoning status limits resistance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even powerful Heroic Spirit summoned as Servant cannot beat Shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Servant summoning status limits resistance.

contexts.japanese: いかに強力な英霊であろうと、その身がサーヴァントとして召喚された以上、あの“黒い影”には敵わない。
contexts.english: No matter how powerful a Heroic Spirit is, it can't beat the Shadow because it's a summoned Servant.

counterexamples.description: Knowledge remains unexplained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He understands vaguely without reason.
counterexamples.explanation: Knowledge remains unexplained.

contexts.japanese: それを、理由もなく漠然と理解した。
contexts.english: I just know that, somehow.

counterexamples.description: Shadow drains surrounding magical energy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forest dies as all local mana pulled in.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow drains surrounding magical energy.

contexts.japanese: 周囲にある全ての魔力があの影に吸われていく。
contexts.english: All of the surrounding mana is being sucked into the Shadow.

counterexamples.description: Overfilled water-balloon image remains premonition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Still pouring into near-bursting balloon.
counterexamples.explanation: Overfilled water-balloon image remains premonition.

contexts.japanese: もういっぱいではちきれそうな風船に、まだ水を注いでいる。
contexts.english: The balloon is engorged and still filling.

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes imminent engulfment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Staying means complete consumption.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes imminent engulfment.

contexts.japanese: 「ま—ずい」
contexts.english: "Oh...crap."

contexts.japanese: ここにいては完全に呑み込まれる。
contexts.english: We'll be completely swallowed by it here.

counterexamples.description: Shirou assumes Berserker's protective role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Must take his place guarding Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou assumes Berserker's protective role.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーの代わりを果たさなければ—！
contexts.english: in Berserker's place!

counterexamples.description: Body feels at risk of being blown away.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Compressed release produces violent wave.
counterexamples.explanation: Body feels at risk of being blown away.

contexts.japanese: 体が吹き飛ばされそうだ。
contexts.english: I feel like my body's about to be blown away.

counterexamples.description: Body and self loss are paired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ruby links body with self in shock.
counterexamples.explanation: Body and self loss are paired.

contexts.japanese: 体が、ない。
contexts.english: I have no self. No body.

counterexamples.description: Right arm resists Shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Functioning right side opposes taking Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Right arm resists Shadow.

contexts.japanese: それに、右腕で懸命に抗った。
contexts.english: I use my right arm to resist as best as I can.

counterexamples.description: Loss is beyond left shoulder.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Only left-side portion gone, not whole body/numbness.
counterexamples.explanation: Loss is beyond left shoulder.

contexts.japanese: なくなったのは、左肩の向こうだけ。
contexts.english: I'm only missing everything from my left shoulder.

counterexamples.description: Shock-driven minimization repeats body remains.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He reassures himself twice despite enormous loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Shock-driven minimization repeats body remains.

contexts.japanese: 体はちゃんと残っている。残っている。
contexts.english: My body is still here. I'm still here.

counterexamples.description: Immense loss despite partial survival remains.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not all self collapsed, yet missing part feels like body gone.
counterexamples.explanation: Immense loss despite partial survival remains.

contexts.japanese:
“俺のすべてが崩れ去ったわけじゃないのに。でも—”
まるで体がなくなってしまったと思うほど、大きく何かが欠けてしまった。
contexts.english:
"It's not like every part of me got wiped out. But..."
I still feel a deep sense of loss, as if I really have lost my whole body.

counterexamples.description: Shadow exhaustion remains conjectural.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Perhaps spent power, melts without trace.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow exhaustion remains conjectural.

contexts.japanese: 今ので力を使い果たしたのか、“黒い影”は跡形もなく溶けていった。
contexts.english: The Shadow melts away without a trace, as if it's expended all its power.

counterexamples.description: Second darkness is distinguished from black sun.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Black sun gone; consciousness now fails.
counterexamples.explanation: Second darkness is distinguished from black sun.

contexts.japanese: 森に黒い太陽はもうない。
contexts.english: The black sun is gone.

counterexamples.description: Distances and intended rescue steps remain prospective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Five meters to Rin, ten more to Shadow; run, take hand, jump sideways.
counterexamples.explanation: Distances and intended rescue steps remain prospective.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂まで五メートルほど、黒い影は更に十メートル先だ、全力で走って、遠坂の手を引いて真横に跳べば、それで—
contexts.english: I'm about five meters from Tohsaka, and the Shadow is another ten meters away. If I run as fast as I can, grab her hand and jump to the side, I can—

counterexamples.description: Shadow bursts instantaneously.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Expansion ruptures in one moment before hand reached.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow bursts instantaneously.

contexts.japanese: 膨張した影の破裂は、一瞬だった。
contexts.english: The swollen Shadow burst in an instant.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の手を取る事も出来ない。
contexts.english: I couldn't even grab Tohsaka's hand.

counterexamples.description: Lethal jungle fever remains figurative bodily destruction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Heat rise imagined as tropical fatal fever.
counterexamples.explanation: Lethal jungle fever remains figurative bodily destruction.

contexts.japanese: 熱帯の森に潜む致死の熱病が、人の体を壊していく。
contexts.english: A lethal jungle fever destroys my body.

counterexamples.description: Mind dies before body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mental death temporally precedes flesh consumption.
counterexamples.explanation: Mind dies before body.

contexts.japanese: —精神が、体より先に死んだ。
contexts.english: ...my mind dies before my body.

counterexamples.description: Soulless flesh is swallowed after mental loss.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body deprived of soul/heart then consumed.
counterexamples.explanation: Soulless flesh is swallowed after mental loss.

contexts.japanese: 魂を失った肉はあっけなく呑まれていく。
contexts.english: My soulless body is swallowed.

counterexamples.description: Shirou minimizes condition to unusable left arm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Claims can still fight.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou minimizes condition to unusable left arm.

contexts.japanese: 「そんな事あるもんか。左腕が使えないだけの話だ。俺はまだ戦える」
contexts.english: "That's not true. I can't use my left arm, but I can still fight."

counterexamples.description: Sakura's decline drives Shirou's fighting, which hastens his death.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Causal chain is commitment-mediated.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's decline drives Shirou's fighting, which hastens his death.

contexts.japanese: いいかね衛宮士郎。おまえも危うい体だが、間桐桜は更に危うい爆弾を抱えている。おまえは戦わなければ無事だが、間桐桜は刻一刻と崩壊している。だからこそおまえは戦いを止められない。戦闘が、自らの死期を早めると承知した上で」
contexts.english: Listen well, Shirou Emiya. Your condition may be precarious, but Sakura Matou carries an even more disastrous bomb. You may be fine as long as you don't fight, but Sakura Matou is falling apart with each passing hour. That is why you cannot stop fighting, even if you know it will hasten your demise."

counterexamples.description: Handshake is vigorous without specifying which hand.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He grips Rin's hand and swings it.
counterexamples.explanation: Handshake is vigorous without specifying which hand.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の手を握って、ぶんぶんと振り回す。
contexts.english: I shake her hand vigorously.

counterexamples.description: Shirou falls while still holding Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The blast/wind overwhelms him, but the rescue grip remains.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou falls while still holding Illya.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを抱きかかえ、暴風に耐え切れず地面に倒れる。
contexts.english: The wind pushes me to the ground, Illya still in my arms.

counterexamples.description: Shock makes Shirou forget even the act of standing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This exceeds physical inability in the preceding line.
counterexamples.explanation: Shock makes Shirou forget even the act of standing.

contexts.japanese: 立ち上がる事さえ、忘れてしまった。
contexts.english: I can't even remember to stand.

counterexamples.description: Berserker's last blow is only a tentative cause of the broken helm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou infers it with だろう.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker's last blow is only a tentative cause of the broken helm.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーの最後の一撃だろう。
contexts.english: It must have been thanks to Berserker's last attack.

counterexamples.description: Shadow tangles Archer's feet.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The restraint explains his abnormal difficulty.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow tangles Archer's feet.

contexts.japanese: 見ればあいつの足元にも、黒い影が絡まり始めていた。
contexts.english: I look and see that his feet are tangled in the Shadow, too.

counterexamples.description: Saber states that pure Heroic Spirits cannot resist the curse layer.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is her attributed explanation of Archer's condition.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber states that pure Heroic Spirits cannot resist the curse layer.

contexts.japanese: 正純の英霊では、アレの呪界層には逆らえん。今の貴様は、この森に満ちる怨霊と大差がない」
contexts.english: A pure Heroic Spirit could never resist that thing's cursed realm. Right now, you are little different from the wraiths roaming these woods."

counterexamples.description: The Shadow is Shirou's guessed reason Saber stopped.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks whether that is the explanation.
counterexamples.explanation: The Shadow is Shirou's guessed reason Saber stopped.

contexts.japanese: ……まさか、セイバーが剣を止めた理由とはアレか。
contexts.english: Don't tell me she stopped her sword because of that.

counterexamples.description: The emerging Shadow is recognized as the park's unknown curse mass.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Identity remains descriptive rather than a named entity.
counterexamples.explanation: The emerging Shadow is recognized as the park's unknown curse mass.

contexts.japanese: 呪いの塊としか言えない、正体不明の存在だ—
contexts.english: that I saw before in the park...

counterexamples.description: Rin recalls Shirou to the present paired threats.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow approaches while Assassin's skull mask smiles.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin recalls Shirou to the present paired threats.

contexts.japanese: —目前にはヒタヒタと近寄ってくる“黒い影”と、髑髏の面を笑いに歪めたアサシンがいる。
contexts.english: Right now, we're facing the creeping black Shadow and the Assassin with the skull mask locked into a smile.

counterexamples.description: Pain runs from shoulder into chest when heat exceeds normal temperature.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The event recurs as the arm heats while walking.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain runs from shoulder into chest when heat exceeds normal temperature.

contexts.japanese: それが平熱を大きく逸脱した瞬間、ズシャ、と肩口から胸に痛みが突き刺さる。
contexts.english: Whenever it gets too far away from my normal body temperature, fresh pain stabs into my chest from the tip of my shoulder.

counterexamples.description: Heat and foreign intrusion are joined in a cutting sensation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The injected foreignness feels sharper than ordinary heating.
counterexamples.explanation: Heat and foreign intrusion are joined in a cutting sensation.

contexts.japanese: 熱の挿入感は鋭利で、加熱というより斬撃に近い。
contexts.english: I have the acute sensation of something foreign being injected, and it feels more like being cut than heated.

counterexamples.description: Earlier Berserker and Rider injuries are invoked as comparison.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou contrasts familiar catastrophic wounds with rejection by his own attached arm.
counterexamples.explanation: Earlier Berserker and Rider injuries are invoked as comparison.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーに腹を根こそぎ持っていかれた事も、ライダーに肋を砕かれかけた事もある。
contexts.english: Berserker's torn my stomach open before, and Rider's caved my rib cage in.

counterexamples.description: Being pierced by his own arm uniquely horrifies Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The paradox matters beyond raw severity.
counterexamples.explanation: Being pierced by his own arm uniquely horrifies Shirou.

contexts.japanese: そんなダメージを経験してさえ、自分の腕に自分の体が“貫かれる”のは寒気がした。
contexts.english: Even though I've experienced damage like that before, the thought of my own arm "stabbing" my body gives me chills.

counterexamples.description: Shirou cannot establish time or place.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His reasoning remains badly impaired.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou cannot establish time or place.

contexts.japanese: どう理性を絞っても、今が何時で此処が何処なのかさえ確認できない。
contexts.english: I think as hard as I can, but I can't tell what, when, or where this is.

counterexamples.description: Room heat versus body heat remains unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He explicitly cannot tell which is hot.
counterexamples.explanation: Room heat versus body heat remains unresolved.

contexts.japanese: ……あの部屋が暑いのか、自分の体が熱いのか。
contexts.english: ...Was the room hot, or was it just me?

counterexamples.description: Sudden pain drives Shirou to his knees.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The event interrupts the unfinished thought.
counterexamples.explanation: Sudden pain drives Shirou to his knees.

contexts.japanese: 不意の痛覚に串刺しにされ、地面に膝をついた。
contexts.english: Suddenly, stabbing pain drives me to my knees.

counterexamples.description: The second awakening is regained alertness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pain clears the confusion rather than proving another sleep cycle.
counterexamples.explanation: The second awakening is regained alertness.

contexts.japanese: ……目が覚めた。
contexts.english: ...I'm awake.

counterexamples.description: The left arm is identified as heat and pain source.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou grasps it after clarity returns.
counterexamples.explanation: The left arm is identified as heat and pain source.

contexts.japanese: 熱と痛みの元凶である左腕をぎゅっと掴む。
contexts.english: I clutch my left arm, the source of the heat and pain.

counterexamples.description: Cloth-causation remains Shirou's question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether the binding itself hurts the arm.
counterexamples.explanation: Cloth-causation remains Shirou's question.

contexts.japanese: それでふと、この布こそが左腕を痛ませているのではないか、と考えた。
contexts.english: Then, I wonder if it's the cloth that's hurting my arm.

counterexamples.description: Removing the cloth is explicitly an enticing delusion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The tempting thought is not validated medical advice.
counterexamples.explanation: Removing the cloth is explicitly an enticing delusion.

contexts.japanese: 口にした妄想は、ひどく魅力的だった。
contexts.english: It's a terribly enticing delusion.

counterexamples.description: Shirou has not seen under the red cloth.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His theory lacks direct inspection.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou has not seen under the red cloth.

contexts.japanese: そもそも、自分はこの赤い布の中身を見ていない。
contexts.english: I haven't even seen what's under the red cloth yet.

counterexamples.description: Shirou imagines his familiar original arm remains.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is the rationalization continuing from the delusion label.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou imagines his familiar original arm remains.

contexts.japanese: ホントは俺の腕はなんともなっていなくて、この布を解けば、馴れ親しんだ自分の腕がある。
contexts.english: Nothing's that wrong with my arm. Maybe if I unwrap it, it'll just be the same old arm I've always known.

counterexamples.description: The fragmented recoil orders the cloth put back on.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fear, pain and broken perception accompany urgent rewrapping.
counterexamples.explanation: The fragmented recoil orders the cloth put back on.

contexts.japanese: 死—　　　急げ　　早く、早く戻さないと
contexts.english: die—       hurry          put it, put it back on

counterexamples.description: The exposed arm feels no longer Shirou's.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is a broken sensory realization under the cloth.
counterexamples.explanation: The exposed arm feels no longer Shirou's.

contexts.japanese: もう、俺のものとは別の腕が—
contexts.english: this isn't my arm

counterexamples.description: Shirou cannot understand the intervening event.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The gap follows brief removal.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou cannot understand the intervening event.

contexts.japanese: その後に何が起こったのか、まったく理解できない。
contexts.english: I don't understand what happened after that.

counterexamples.description: He cannot remember events only seconds old.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The duration is explicit and the memory gap survives rebinding.
counterexamples.explanation: He cannot remember events only seconds old.

contexts.japanese: ほんの数秒前の事なのに、それがまったく思い出せない—
contexts.english: It took place just a few seconds ago, but I can't remember it at all...

counterexamples.description: Shirou concludes unwrapping will kill him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The warning is accepted after direct exposure.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou concludes unwrapping will kill him.

contexts.japanese: 解けば死ぬ。
contexts.english: If I take it off, I'll die.

counterexamples.description: Fear dulling sharpness becomes the mind going dull.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The readiness metaphor concerns judgment and resolve.
counterexamples.explanation: Fear dulling sharpness becomes the mind going dull.

contexts.japanese: 恐怖で、切れ味が鈍くなる。
contexts.english: My mind will go dull from the terror.

counterexamples.description: The arm's future pain remains unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No prognosis is supplied.
counterexamples.explanation: The arm's future pain remains unknown.

contexts.japanese: 腕の鈍痛がこの先どうなるか自分にも判らない。
contexts.english: I don't know what the dull pain in my arm is going to turn into next.

counterexamples.description: Shirou rejects the convenient arm fantasy as absurd.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No unwrapping occurs in this branch.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou rejects the convenient arm fantasy as absurd.

contexts.japanese: そんな馬鹿な話はない。
contexts.english: I'm being absurd.

counterexamples.description: The black Shadow remains unidentified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou lists it among unresolved forces.
counterexamples.explanation: The black Shadow remains unidentified.

contexts.japanese: 未だ正体の掴めない黒い影。
contexts.english: The black Shadow that I still don't understand.

counterexamples.description: The Shadow contracts then expands through a pufferfish image.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The grotesque comparison is visual and sequential.
counterexamples.explanation: The Shadow contracts then expands through a pufferfish image.

contexts.japanese: 影は枯れ木のように縮んだあと、河豚のように膨れ上がった。
contexts.english: It shrinks like a withered tree, and then expands like a pufferfish.

counterexamples.description: Only Shirou's protruding left arm misses the sheltering luck.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The sentence anticipates the loss without describing voluntary sacrifice.
counterexamples.explanation: Only Shirou's protruding left arm misses the sheltering luck.

contexts.japanese: ただ、窪みから出ていた左腕だけは、その幸運に与れずに—
contexts.english: But his exposed left arm was not so lucky...

counterexamples.description: Shirou protected the silver-haired girl and lost the left arm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The viewpoint does not confuse Illya with Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou protected the silver-haired girl and lost the left arm.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎は銀髪の少女を庇って、左腕を影に呑まれた。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya protected the silver-haired girl, and the Shadow swallowed his arm.

counterexamples.description: Insects remain a comparison for invasive heat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They are not identified as Sakura's crest worms.
counterexamples.explanation: Insects remain a comparison for invasive heat.

contexts.japanese: 肩の付け根から侵入する熱は、細胞を食う極小の蟲のようだ。
contexts.english: The heat seeping in from my shoulder joint is like thousands of microscopic bugs eating my cells.

counterexamples.description: The sealed-pan image threatens Shirou with charring.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Relaxing vigilance risks being burned black.
counterexamples.explanation: The sealed-pan image threatens Shirou with charring.

contexts.japanese: じゅうじゅうと音をたてて、気を抜けばいつのまにか真っ黒焦げになっている。
contexts.english: There's a sizzling sound. If I relax, I might find myself burned black.

counterexamples.description: Heat melts Shirou's mind rather than body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The dream threatens identity and cognition.
counterexamples.explanation: Heat melts Shirou's mind rather than body.

contexts.japanese: 熱は、体ではなく心を溶かす。
contexts.english: The heat melts my mind, not my body.

counterexamples.description: Shirou wonders whether the nightmare will end.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No recovery is certified before waking.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou wonders whether the nightmare will end.

contexts.japanese: ……その、悪い夢がついに終わるのか。
contexts.english: ...Will this nightmare finally end?

counterexamples.description: Foreign flesh seals the shoulder opening.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The transplant is experienced as alien blockage.
counterexamples.explanation: Foreign flesh seals the shoulder opening.

contexts.japanese: その入り口—連中を外に出すべき穴が、自分以外の肉片で塞がれた—！
contexts.english: The entrance—the hole they should leave through is blocked by flesh that isn't my own...!

counterexamples.description: The right hand scratches Shirou's chest during pain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The usable side remains explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: The right hand scratches Shirou's chest during pain.

contexts.japanese: 痛みに耐えかねて、右腕で胸を掻き毟る。
contexts.english: I'm unable to bear the pain, my right hand scratching at my chest.

counterexamples.description: Illya tells Shirou to suppress the left arm rather than endure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The instruction concerns containment.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya tells Shirou to suppress the left arm rather than endure.

contexts.japanese: 「シロウ……！？　落ち着いて、我慢するんじゃなくて左腕を抑えつけるの……！」
contexts.english: "Shirou...!? Try to relax. You need to suppress the left arm, not just put up with it...!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou builds a barrier preventing alien mixture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The action produces temporary control, not cure.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou builds a barrier preventing alien mixture.

contexts.japanese: 要は関を作って、異物が本体に混ざらないよう努めればいいだけだ。
contexts.english: I just need to build a barrier to prevent the alien parts from mixing with my own body.

counterexamples.description: The attached arm is framed as a natural-law-defying foreign body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Its wrongness is perceptible despite cloth.
counterexamples.explanation: The attached arm is framed as a natural-law-defying foreign body.

contexts.japanese: それは本来在ってはならないモノ、自然の摂理を押し曲げてまで取り付けた“異物”だった。
contexts.english: It's something alien that defies the laws of nature, that should never be attached to me.

counterexamples.description: The dream includes a ruined nest and black pupa.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No explicit identity is supplied.
counterexamples.explanation: The dream includes a ruined nest and black pupa.

contexts.japanese: 廃墟の巣穴。
contexts.english: A ruined nest.

counterexamples.description: The speaker has no memory of birth.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The origin remains unknown.
counterexamples.explanation: The speaker has no memory of birth.

contexts.japanese: 誕生の記憶はない。
contexts.english: I have no memory of my birth.

counterexamples.description: The speaker says she did not invite the approaching people.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The interaction is unwanted.
counterexamples.explanation: The speaker says she did not invite the approaching people.

contexts.japanese: 私から誘った覚えはありません。
contexts.english: I don't remember asking them to come.

counterexamples.description: Fear prompts an attempt to go home.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The pursuers' later protection claims are coercive mockery.
counterexamples.explanation: Fear prompts an attempt to go home.

contexts.japanese: 怖くなったので帰りましょう。
contexts.english: They're scaring me. Time to go home.

counterexamples.description: The pursuers frame coercion as protection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fragmented speech remains incomplete.
counterexamples.explanation: The pursuers frame coercion as protection.

contexts.japanese: 「はは—は！　そう—な、ってコト—にか、俺たちで保護してあげ—とダメって—？」
contexts.english: "Haha—ha! Yea—mean—we'd better—protect—right?"

counterexamples.description: The group continues chasing her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No consent is implied.
counterexamples.explanation: The group continues chasing her.

contexts.japanese: てくてく彼らは追ってきます。
contexts.english: They keep chasing me.

counterexamples.description: After the stomach rumbles, voices turn to panic and pleas.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Violence remains conveyed through sound.
counterexamples.explanation: After the stomach rumbles, voices turn to panic and pleas.

contexts.japanese: 「ひ、ひや、—逃げんなこら、助けてく—えええ！」
contexts.english: "Eeek—don't run, asshole, help—eee!"

counterexamples.description: The phrasing later shifts to dreaming of the breeding box.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This would contrast with the opening location if preserved.
counterexamples.explanation: The phrasing later shifts to dreaming of the breeding box.

contexts.japanese: 飼育箱の夢を見る。
contexts.english: I dream of a box for breeding bugs.

counterexamples.description: Rin explicitly credits Shirou's own power with completing the healing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her help did not replace the self-repair that actually closed the wound.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin explicitly credits Shirou's own power with completing the healing.

contexts.japanese: 「ここで重要なのは、貴方は貴方一人で生ききったっていう事実よ。確かにわたしは手助けしたけど、あの傷を完治させたのは貴方自身の力だった。そこ、勘違いしないでよね」
contexts.english: "What's important here is that you managed to survive on your own. I might have helped a bit, but it was your power that healed your wound. So, don't get that twisted, okay?"

contexts.japanese: 「話を聞くとそうみたいだけど。なんだ、遠坂が治してくれたんじゃないのか？」
contexts.english: "That's what it sounds like from the way you told it. So you aren't the one who healed me?"

counterexamples.description: Rin keeps the Servant-link mechanism qualified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She proposes a powerful Saber, a summoning mistake or both, connected by some line.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin keeps the Servant-link mechanism qualified.

contexts.japanese: 「そうなると原因はサーヴァントね。
contexts.english: "Which means it must be your Servant.

contexts.japanese: 貴方のサーヴァントはよっぽど強力なのか、それとも召喚の時に何か手違いが生じたのか。……ま、両方だと思うけど、何らかのラインが繋がったんでしょうね」
contexts.english: Either your Servant is pretty powerful, or something happened when you summoned them... I think it's both, actually, but you must be connected by some line."

counterexamples.description: The abnormal reverse flow of a familiar's ability remains explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber's regeneration may flow to Shirou, reversing the usual mage-to-familiar grant.
counterexamples.explanation: The abnormal reverse flow of a familiar's ability remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「見たところセイバーには自然治癒の力もあるみたいだから、それが貴方に流れてるんじゃないかな。
contexts.english: "Saber can evidently regenerate too, so her power might be flowing into you.

contexts.japanese: 普通は魔術師の能力が使い魔に付与されるんだけど、貴方の場合は使い魔の特殊能力が主人を助けてるってワケ」
contexts.english: Normally the mage's abilities are shared with their familiar, but in your case, the familiar's abilities are helping the Master."

counterexamples.description: The gasoline-engine model stays distinct from a recorded pseudo-immortality exception.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ordinary Master support is fuel consumption; a past Master physically fused with a Servant and lived while it lived.
counterexamples.explanation: The gasoline-engine model stays distinct from a recorded pseudo-immortality exception.

contexts.japanese: 「マスターとサーヴァントの繋がりなんて、ガソリンとエンジンみたいなものだもの。こっちが魔力を提供して、あっちがそれを食べるだけ。
contexts.english: "The connection between Master and Servant is like gas and an engine. We provide the energy for them to consume.

contexts.japanese: ……まあ中には肉体面でもサーヴァントと共融して擬似的な“不死”を得たマスターもいたそうよ。サーヴァントが死なない限り自分も死なない、なんていうヤツなんだけど……衛宮くん、人の話聞いてる？」
contexts.english: ...Though, I've read that a Master once acquired pseudo-immortality by physically fusing with their Servant. They wouldn't die as long as their Servant doesn't die... Are you listening, Emiya?"

counterexamples.description: Rin's warning about unknown extra healing costs remains speculative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She is certain something besides Saber's mana is consumed but jokes through possible lifespan, luck and savings.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's warning about unknown extra healing costs remains speculative.

contexts.japanese: 「バカね、そんな理由じゃないわよ。断言してもいいけど、貴方の傷を治すと減るのはセイバーの魔力だけじゃない。
contexts.english: "That's not the point, dummy. Let me be clear: it costs more than Saber's magical energy to heal your wounds.

contexts.japanese: —貴方、それ絶対なんか使ってるわ。
contexts.english: You're giving something up when it happens.

contexts.japanese: 寿命とか勝負運とか預金残高とか、ともかく何かが減りまくってるに違いないんだから」
contexts.english: Whether that's your life, your luck, or even your bank account, you can bet that kind of healing doesn't come cheap."

counterexamples.description: Just before midnight Shirou begins his habitual inward-focused practice rather than going to sleep.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Breathing and attention precede circuit induction.
counterexamples.explanation: Just before midnight Shirou begins his habitual inward-focused practice rather than going to sleep.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page0:1
contexts.japanese: そうして一日が終わる。
contexts.english: And that is how my day ends.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page0:1
contexts.japanese: 深夜零時前、衛宮士郎は日課になっている“魔術”を行わなくてはならない。
contexts.english: Just before midnight, Shirou Emiya must perform the daily routine of utilizing magecraft.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page1:1
contexts.japanese: 結跏趺坐に姿勢をとり、呼吸を整える。
contexts.english: I cross my legs, take my position, and regulate my breathing.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page1:1
contexts.japanese: 頭の中はできるだけ白紙に。
contexts.english: I try to empty my mind.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page1:1
contexts.japanese: 外界との接触はさけ、意識は全て内界に向ける。
contexts.english: I ignore everything around me and turn my focus inward.

counterexamples.description: Trace On remains an incantation functioning as self-directed conditioning for a practitioner without crest or broad magical education.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The passage does not declare all incantations meaningless.
counterexamples.explanation: Trace On remains an incantation functioning as self-directed conditioning for a practitioner without crest or broad magical education.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page2:1
contexts.japanese: 「—同調、開始」
contexts.english: "Trace On."

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page2:1
contexts.japanese: 否、それは本当に自己暗示にすぎない。
contexts.english: No, this is a kind of hypnosis.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page2:1
contexts.japanese: 魔術刻印とやらがなく、魔道の知識もない自分にとって、呪文は自分を変革させる為だけの物だ。
contexts.english: With no Magic Crest and no magical knowledge, the incantation I mutter is really just a way to focus myself and change my body.

counterexamples.description: Ordinary humans lack the relevant mana-carrying nerve, so Shirou creates one temporarily through a genuinely painful bodily process.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The rod's pain is not dismissed as metaphor.
counterexamples.explanation: Ordinary humans lack the relevant mana-carrying nerve, so Shirou creates one temporarily through a genuinely painful bodily process.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page3:1
contexts.japanese: ……本来、人間の体に魔力を通す神経はない。
contexts.english: Typically, humans do not have any lines which allow magical energy to pass through their body.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page4:1
contexts.japanese: 魔術は自己との戦いだ。
contexts.english: Magecraft is a battle with yourself.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page4:1
contexts.japanese: 例えば、この瞬間、背骨に焼けた鉄の棒を突き刺していく。
contexts.english: For example, I insert a burning steel rod into my backbone.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page4:1
contexts.japanese: その鉄の棒こそ、たった一本だけ用意できる自分の“魔術回路”だ。
contexts.english: The steel rod itself is the one and only Magic Circuit I can prepare for myself.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page5:1
contexts.japanese: それは比喩ではない。
contexts.english: This is not a metaphor.

counterexamples.description: Kiritsugu warns that magecraft leaves ordinary morality, approaches killing and death, and is a path of self-destruction; child Shirou nods without fear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The warning remains Kiritsugu's speech.
counterexamples.explanation: Kiritsugu warns that magecraft leaves ordinary morality, approaches killing and death, and is a path of self-destruction; child Shirou nods without fear.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page20:1
contexts.japanese: —いいかい士郎。魔術を習う、という事は常識からかけ離れるという事だ。死ぬ時は死に、殺す時は殺す。
contexts.english: Listen, Shirou. Learning magecraft means leaving behind common sense. You die when the end comes for you, and you kill when you must.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page20:1
contexts.japanese: 僕たちの本質は生ではなく死だからね。魔術とは、自らを滅ぼす道に他ならない—
contexts.english: Life isn't at the core of what we do, death is. Magecraft is walking the path of self-destruction.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page21:1
contexts.japanese: 幼い心は恐れを知らなかったのだろう。
contexts.english: I guess I knew no fear as a child.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page21:1
contexts.japanese: 強く頷く衛宮士郎の頭に、切嗣は仕方なげに手を置いて苦笑していた。
contexts.english: Kiritsugu smiled bitterly, placing a hand atop my head as I nodded enthusiastically.

counterexamples.description: A distracting thought misaligns the induced circuit; loss of breathing control would be fatal, but Shirou recovers and completes one pseudo-nerve.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Death and bodily destruction remain conditional rather than accomplished.
counterexamples.explanation: A distracting thought misaligns the induced circuit; loss of breathing control would be fatal, but Shirou recovers and completes one pseudo-nerve.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page24:1
セイバールート一日目-15:page24:1
contexts.japanese: ……雑念が入った。
contexts.english: I got distracted.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page24:1
contexts.japanese: ぎしり、と、背骨に突き刺さった鉄の棒が、入ってはいけないところにズレていく感覚。
contexts.english: I feel the uncomfortable sensation of the iron rod in my backbone moving where it shouldn't.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.english: "Ungh...guh...ugh!"

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: ここで呼吸を乱せば、それこそ取り返しがつかない。
contexts.english: Losing control of my breathing now would be fatal.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: 擬似的に作られた魔術回路は肉体を侵食し、体内をズタズタにする。
contexts.english: The pseudo-Magic Circuits would overwhelm my body and shred it to pieces.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: そうなれば終わりだ。
contexts.english: And that would be the end of me.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎は、こんな初歩の手法に失敗して命を落とした半人前という事になる—
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya would simply be a novice who died because he failed at an elementary step.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: かみ砕きかねないほど歯を食いしばり、接続を再開する。
contexts.english: I grit my teeth and try to recover my connection.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: 針の山を歩く鬩ぎ合いの末、鉄の棒は身体の奥まで到達し、ようやく肉体の一部として融解した。
contexts.english: After pain like walking through a storm of needles, the iron rod finally sinks deep within my body and fuses with me.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: それだけの時間をかけ、ようやく一本だけ擬似神経を作り、自らを、魔力を生成する回路と成す。
contexts.english: And after all that time, I'm finally able to create one pseudo-circuit...a circuit capable of creating magical energy using my own self.

counterexamples.description: Foreign mana is likened to poison or alien blood that must pass through structural gaps; the attempt fails and disperses without changing the pipe.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The pipe does not explode or collapse.
counterexamples.explanation: Foreign mana is likened to poison or alien blood that must pass through structural gaps; the attempt fails and disperses without changing the pipe.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page30:1
contexts.japanese: そもそも、自分以外のモノに自分の魔力を通す、という事は毒物を混入させるに等しい。
contexts.english: Passing magical energy into something other than yourself is like mixing poison.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page30:1
contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎の血は、鉄パイプにとって血ではないのと同じ事。異なる血を通せば強化どころか崩壊を早めるだけだろう。
contexts.english: My blood is a far cry from the blood of an iron pipe. Forcing an entirely different sort of blood through an object may well destroy it rather than enhance it.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page30:1
contexts.japanese: それを防ぎ、毒物を薬物とする為には対象の構造を正確に把握し、“空いている透き間”に魔力を通さなければならない。
contexts.english: To prevent that from happening, I need to properly understand an object's structure and pass magical energy into it between the small vacant spaces.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1
contexts.japanese: 「—、—っ、構成材質、補強」
contexts.english: "Composition, reinforce."

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1
contexts.japanese: ……熟練した魔術師ならば容易いのだろうが、魔力の生成さえ満足にいかない自分にとって、それは何百メートル先の標的を射抜くぐらいの難易度だ。
contexts.english: This may be easy for a skilled mage, but since I have a hard time generating magical energy in the first place, even a task like this is as difficult as shooting an arrow and hitting a target several hundred meters from you.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1
